Deposits and repayments consume configured MYT vault shares, not raw USDC or native ETH. MYT, underlying token, position NFT, token adapter, transmuter, fee vault, rate and risk settings are storage-configured dependencies; documentation mapping is not live dependency/configuration verification.

tokenId/accountId identifies an NFT position. withdraw, mint and selfLiquidate require caller equals NFT owner; operator approvals are not enough. Existing-position deposit may fund somebody else without transferring ownership; recipient determines NFT owner only when tokenId=0.

functions.label: Reservoir wsrUSD deposit
warnings: Ethereum Savingcoin wsrUSD takes and returns rUSD (0x09D4214C03D01F49544C0448DBE3A27f768F2b34), not srUSD or USDC. Assets and shares both use 18-decimal raw units. It is not a 1:1 srUSD wrapper: deposit/mint burn caller rUSD and mint wsrUSD; withdraw/redeem burn wsrUSD and mint rUSD.

Deposit/mint require rUSD balance and allowance to this wsrUSD contract. The manager-controlled notional cap is checked in _deposit, but inherited maxDeposit/maxMint return uint256 max and do not report cap availability. Cap starts at zero in the constructor; current cap and rate were not read by RPC. Check transaction conditions before signing.

All four conversion paths use integer floor division because Savingcoin ignores the requested ERC4626 rounding direction, including mint and withdraw (normally ceil). Small nonzero amounts may produce zero shares or zero assets; mint can undercharge by rounding and withdraw can burn fewer shares than standard ERC4626 rounding. No minimum output, maximum input or deadline argument protects a quote.

Rate is manager-controlled and accrues by block timestamp using a third-order binomial approximation in RAY (1e27), not an exact exponent and not a fixed APY. Accumulated factor and currentRate determine conversion; token donations/balanceOf do not. The apy() getter returns the one-year compounded factor including principal in RAY, not the advertised percentage net of principal.

No lock, maturity, cooldown, queue, settlement or fee is implemented by these wsrUSD calls. Exit pays newly minted rUSD immediately, not USDC; converting rUSD to collateral through the PSM is separate, unadmitted and liquidity-dependent. Delegated exit requires sufficient owner wsrUSD allowance; receiver must be nonzero.

Ordinary calls have no user role/whitelist or pause modifier in the reviewed Savingcoin and rUSD sources. However exits require wsrUSD to retain rUSD MINTER permission, which rUSD administrators can revoke; all exits revert if that dependency is removed. Historical successful redemption is evidence for its transaction block only, not a current role attestation. Managers can change cap/rate; administrators can change manager/minter roles.

Official savings documentation restricts eligibility to non-US users and non-sanctioned countries; absence of on-chain user gating is not permission to bypass legal eligibility. Respect the current protocol terms.

functions.label: Strata srUSDe deposit USDe
warnings: Ethereum srUSDe is the senior tranche, not jrUSDe. Amounts are integer raw token/share units, not fiat. USDe is the base asset; the token overloads support the strategy USDe/sUSDe assets only and are not arbitrary-token zaps. USDe, sUSDe and srUSDe amounts are not interchangeable or guaranteed 1:1.

Deposit/mint pull the selected input from msg.sender after approval to srUSDe and mint shares to receiver. Withdrawal/redeem burn owner shares; caller != owner requires sufficient srUSDe share allowance to caller. receiver is the payout/request beneficiary and can differ from owner; choose the intended nonzero address.

USDe exits create an Ethena unstaking request rather than instant USDe delivery under active cooldown; docs currently describe seven days and a separate manual claim. Finalization uses token=sUSDe, user=the exit receiver and pays USDe to the recorded receiver, not to the finalization caller.

sUSDe exits use ERC20Cooldown: docs currently describe instant payout, but the strategy senior cooldown is role-configurable up to seven days. A nonzero cooldown instead queues sUSDe under receiver and requires ERC20Cooldown.finalize(sUSDe,receiver[,at]). No current cooldown, pause, allowance, supported-token mapping or dependency storage read was performed.

CDO deposit/withdraw action states, accounting caps/coverage and shortfall pausing can block calls. Docs describe senior minting suspension below 105% coverage and 2.5 bps redemption fee; live parameters are not attested. Exit fees are configurable (CDO source allows up to 1%).

All eight tranche methods update accounting before quoting. ERC4626 deposit/redeem floor and mint/withdraw ceil conversions use virtual assets/shares; token conversions add their own floor/ceil rounding. sUSDe withdrawal amount is recomputed by strategy from net base assets using previewWithdraw, so a tokenAmount argument/preview is not a guaranteed exact payout.

Every withdrawal/redeem must leave total srUSDe supply >= 0.1e18 shares (MinSharesViolation); the final holder cannot redeem the entire remaining supply. Zero token/base amounts, insufficient balance/allowance and limits revert. Methods have no min-output, max-input or deadline arguments; previews and exchange rates can change.

Cooldown requests merge at 70 active slots or within the same block and can extend a prior unlock. Distinct owner/receiver exits are rejected when receiver already has 40 active slots. The recorded beneficiary, not the permissionless finalizer, receives the claim.

Proxies and owner/role-controlled configuration remain authoritative. functions.label: Strata srUSDe claim USDe unstake until cutoff
warnings: Only settles existing requests created through the documented Ethena USDe strategy; it does not redeem srUSDe shares or open an unstake request. Use token=sUSDe 0x9D39A5DE30e57443BfF2A8307A4256c8797A3497 and user=the original tranche exit receiver.

UnstakeCooldown calls each recorded clone; its handler finalizes Ethena unstaking and transfers USDe to the recorded receiver, while token argument is sUSDe (not USDe). Docs describe seven-day USDe cooldown; source follows Ethena cooldownEnd, not a hardcoded seven days.
Anyone may finalize for user. Output belongs to the recorded beneficiary, never the finalization caller. The timestamp overload accepts a cutoff at, not an amount, and rejects at > block.timestamp.

Active cooldown requests with unlockAt > at are skipped. When cooldown is disabled by the relevant protocol/worker, maturity filtering is bypassed. NothingToFinalize reverts if no positive amount can be settled. Underlying token/proxy/dependency failure can revert the whole operation.

functions.label: Inverse Finance sDOLA deposit
warnings: Ethereum mainnet sDOLA only. Official docs explicitly shut down sDOLA CCIP lanes in August 2026; historical L2 tokens and all bridge functions are outside this integration.

Underlying is DOLA (0x865377367054516e17014ccded1e7d814edc9ce4), not USDC. Deposits/mints transfer caller DOLA using allowance and stake it in the fixed savings contract; withdrawals/redeems unstake and return DOLA to the chosen receiver. Delegated exits require owner share allowance.

No caller-set minimum shares/maximum assets/deadline. functions.label: Midas mTBILL depositInstant custom recipient
warnings: mTBILL is a tokenized investment product, not an insured bank deposit or a risk-free USDC vault. Issuer, legal/enforceability, custody/counterparty, underlying investment, oracle, upgrade/admin, stablecoin and liquidity risks remain; catalog admission is not an investment-safety determination.

Only eligible users and recipients may transact. Applicable legal terms, jurisdiction restrictions and onboarding/KYC must be independently satisfied. Onchain source enforces conditional greenlisting, blacklisting and configured Chainalysis sanctions checks for sender and custom recipient; no eligibility bypass is admitted or implied. Official eligibility webpage returned HTTP403 during review, so no claim is made that its full current terms were read.

All vault amountToken, amountMTokenIn and minReceiveAmount parameters use base-18 normalized units, including payment tokens such as six-decimal USDC. They are NOT raw USDC units. The implementation converts to the actual token precision and rejects nonrepresentable rounding; token and mTBILL conversion rates are not necessarily 1:1.

Use only currently configured payment tokens after reviewing getPaymentTokens/tokensConfig and token-specific feeds. No arbitrary-token executor or unbound route is admitted. Global and per-selector pauses, token allowance budgets, minimums, data-feed checks, fees and instant daily limits apply; mTBILL issuance also has a supply cap and first-deposit minimum.

Instant deposit transfers caller payment tokens to the configured proceeds/fee recipients then mints mTBILL. Instant redemption directly burns the caller net mTBILL using the vault burner role, transfers any fee using caller allowance, and pays from vault liquidity. User allowance must cover all payment-token transfers and any mTBILL fee transfer; request redemption needs allowance for the full mTBILL transfer.

Request operations are asynchronous and administrator-settled, not instant exits and not a user-claim/epoch mechanism. DepositRequest immediately sends payment tokens away; redeemRequest escrows net mTBILL and transfers fees. A vault admin later approves at a chosen rate (safe variants check tolerance), mints to the recorded recipient or burns escrow and pays from requestRedeemer. There is no ordinary user approve/claim/cancel/refund capability in these ABIs, no fixed fulfillment epoch or bounded waiting time.

rejectRequest is admin-only and merely marks a request canceled in the reviewed implementation; it does not automatically refund payment tokens, escrowed mTBILL or fees. Custom recipient overloads store the beneficiary as request.sender; carefully distinguish funding caller from recipient. Request rate changes, admin rejection, offchain processing and requestRedeemer liquidity/allowance may delay or prevent settlement.

No fresh RPC implementation identity, eligible wallet status, enabled tokens, fees/caps/pauses, balances, liquidity, successful execution or fulfillment timing was verified. Static deployment/ABI evidence grants no signing permission or independent execution-control bypass.

functions.label: Treehouse Deposit ERC20 into tETH
warnings: Treehouse tETH Ethereum only. Inputs/outputs are integer raw token/share units, not fiat or interchangeable ETH equivalents. Router deposit amount uses the selected ERC20 decimals; depositETH uses msg.value wei.

Router constructor binds WETH 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2, stETH 0xae7ab96520DE3A18E5e111B5EaAb095312D7fE84, wstETH 0x7f39C581F595B53c5cb19bD0b3f8dA6c935E2Ca0 and official vault. Only vault-allowable assets work; non-underlying conversion explicitly supports WETH/stETH into wstETH. Not an arbitrary-token zap.

Actual tETH ERC4626 asset is the internal accounting unit (IAU), not WETH/wstETH/ETH. TAsset _deposit/_withdraw requires caller to be an authorized IAU minter. Do not call token ERC4626 deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem as a generic ordinary-user vault; use admitted router/redemption entrypoints.

Router pulls ERC20 from msg.sender after approval to router and mints tETH to msg.sender. Deposit cap and pause checks can revert; router has no minShares or deadline parameter and conversion/rounding can change.

Redemption redeem(uint96) escrows raw tETH shares, not ETH or wstETH assets, and requires tETH approval to Redemption V3. minRedeemInUnderlying is measured in underlying accounting units. No instant payout: finalizeRedeem(index) is a separate transaction after configured waitingPeriod (docs describe approximately seven days).

finalizeRedeem claims only msg.sender indexed request, checks blacklist and maturity, and pays vault underlying wstETH via the allowlisted RedemptionController. Fees and the minimum-of-initiation/finalization exchange-rate haircut reduce output. Vault liquidity, controller authorization and pauses can block claims. Indexes move on deletion; re-read pending requests rather than reusing stale indexes.

redeemWithNft ALWAYS surrenders the caller owned/approved NFT to nftTreasury, even above minimum size. Only exemptionGate accepted collections qualify; disabled gate, zero-worth redemption or unaccepted collection reverts. This is a paid ticket path, not a free whitelist bypass; it does not bypass blacklist/maturity checks.

functions.label: Re Protocol Deposit approved collateral for reUSD
warnings: Re Protocol reUSD is 0x5086bf358635B81D8C47C66d1C8b9E567Db70c72 on Ethereum, not Resupply reUSD. sreUSD is Resupply Savings reUSD and is NOT a Re Protocol wrapper; no sreUSD wrap/unwrap is admitted.

Mandatory KYC/AML or KYB, eligible non-US person/permitted jurisdiction, platform agreement and Token Purchase Agreement/fee schedule apply. Registry approval cannot be bypassed. Direct ICL deposit is for already approved callers; this does not implement the app pre-KYC escrow flow.

ICL deposit(token,amount,minShares) pulls the selected registry-enabled ERC20 from caller after ICL approval. amount is raw input-token units (USDC/USDT typically 6; USDe/sUSDe 18), minShares is raw reUSD share units. Tokens and shares are not 1:1; fee and oracle decimal scaling apply. Registry enablement and prices are not freshly attested.

depositNative(minShares) uses msg.value wei, wraps registry.getWrappedNative(), and only works when that token is enabled. It is not evidence that the current app offers native ETH; official mint docs list USDC/USDT/USDe/sUSDe. Reverts for zero value, disabled token/deposits, KYC or pause.

processPrestakedDeposit(token,amount,minShares,receiver) is a typed on-behalf deposit, not a role-only method: caller pays its own funds and the receiver must be KYC-approved. It does not approve the caller/receiver or lift legal eligibility. Verify the intended receiver and obtain token approval to ICL.

Gateway redeemInstant shares is raw reUSD input; minPayout is raw units of the active payout token, not USD-WAD/share units. Gateway delegates transferFrom to InstantRedemption 0xa31deEbb3680A3007120e74bCbDf4df36F042A40: approve that module, not the gateway, for shares. Dynamic active payout token, fee, reserves, per-wallet/daily caps and minimum/maximum amounts apply; preview does not guarantee execution.

Quarterly submit/adjust/cancel work only in WINDOW mode while submission is open and before deadline. Approve WindowRedemption 0xb5930ad554f9da6783a3dd259a111e9d1bd85b75, not gateway. Shares are escrowed; requests cannot be duplicated. Adjust to zero/cancel returns shares before deadline; cancellation itself has no KYC modifier, but share-token restrictions may still apply.

claimWindowPayout(windowId) requires a settled user request, fresh KYC and claim within 30 days after closeTime. Payout uses snapshotted share price at close and payout-token price at settlement with that token decimals; fees apply, fulfilled shares burn, unfulfilled shares return. Partial fulfillment and zero payout are possible; no instant/full redemption guarantee.

Gateway constructor binds the stated instant/window modules, reUSD token, and KYC registry 0x82F1806AEab5Ecb9a485eb041d5Ed4940b123995. Modules are admin-configurable: constructor binding is not a fresh live getter/configuration attestation. Source comment saying approve gateway is contradicted by actual module transferFrom; the module is the spender.

warnings: Permissioned fund access only: official onboarding requires fund approval, KYC/AML, signed investment agreement, Qualified Purchaser eligibility in supported countries and fund-specific wallet allowlisting. offchainRedeem burns the caller shares and starts offchain fund settlement to the registered payout destination. It does NOT synchronously transfer USDC. USTB and USCC continue as Invesco USTB and Bitwise USCC in current Superstate docs; no retirement notice was encountered in the reviewed product evidence. Fund AUM/whole-protocol TVL and DAU/MAU are not claimed.

functions.label: Falcon Finance Start cooldown for exact USDf
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only: not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity, current configuration, liquidity, backing, balance, financial-safety or successful-execution guarantee. Canonical calldata, grants, allowances, pause scopes and independent execution controls remain mandatory. All admitted functions are nonpayable; send zero native value.

Ethereum sUSDf TransparentUpgradeableProxy 0xc8CF6D7991f15525488b2A83Df53468D682Ba4B0, explorer-reported implementation 0x0D132bEE412E6619a4863AEEdad97541BfDa3F34. Sourcify reports isProxy false for the proxy; proxy compilation/ABI plus Etherscan establish the binding instead. Upgrades can change this interface and behavior.

Underlying is 18-decimal USDf (0xFa2B947eEc368f42195f24F36d2aF29f7c24CeC2), not USDC/USDT. Shares are 18-decimal sUSDf. Deposit/mint pull caller USDf via allowance; delegated withdrawal/cooldown burns owner shares and spends caller share allowance. Amount conversions round according to the deployed OZ ERC4626 implementation.

withdraw/redeem are immediate exits only while cooldownDuration == 0. When cooldownDuration > 0 they revert; use cooldownAssets/cooldownShares to burn shares and transfer USDf into the fixed silo, then unstake(receiver) after the owner cooldown ends. Admin may change duration up to 90 days; current duration is not attested. Each additional cooldown restarts the timer for the owner entire accumulated amount, which stops earning vault yield.

cooldownAssets/cooldownShares book escrow for owner, not caller; unstake claims only msg.sender cooldown and sends the full amount to a nonzero receiver. The silo is vault-only and no direct silo capability is admitted. No claim of complete collateral redemption: USDf-to-original-collateral is a separate KYC/whitelisted process with documented 7-day delay and is not admitted.

Vault deposit/withdraw paths reject zero assets/shares and restricted caller/receiver/owner. Outstanding totalSupply after a vault action must be zero or at least MIN_SHARES=1e18; an action leaving smaller residual supply reverts. Underlying USDf has separate sender/recipient restrictions; vault admin can restrict users and redistribute/burn their shares.

No caller-set minimum output, maximum input or deadline. totalAssets excludes unvested rewards; rewarder-only distributions vest for an admin-set period (maximum 7 days). No explicit vault deposit/exit fee appears in this reviewed implementation; this does not guarantee other system or gas costs.

Official Classic Yield docs describe no lockup/immediate unstaking, but exact implementation supports both cooldown modes and is authoritative. Official FAQ says USDf staking does not require KYC/AML; direct USDf mint/redemption requires KYC, whitelisting and jurisdiction eligibility. Catalog membership grants none of those approvals. No permit, roles, reward administration or fixed-term NFT restaking admitted.

Current official app labels the product wrapping (previously Stake), binds Ethereum STAKING to this exact direct deployment and actively wires OHM→gOHM via stake(to,amount,false,true), gOHM→OHM via unstake(to,amount,false,false), sOHM→gOHM via wrap and sOHM→OHM via unstake(to,amount,false,true). This is not deprecated V1 staking/wsOHM or a claim of current rebase rewards/APY.

Immutable constructor token identities: OHM V2 0x64aa3364F17a4D01c6f1751Fd97C2BD3D7e7f1D5 and sOHM V2 0x04906695D6D12CF5459975d7C3C03356E4Ccd460 use 9 decimals; gOHM 0x0ab87046fBb341D058F17CBC4c1133F25a20a52f uses 18 decimals. stake amount is OHM; wrap amount is sOHM; unwrap amount is gOHM; unstake amount is sOHM when _rebasing=true and gOHM when false. Never interchange units.

OHM staking and sOHM transfer-based unstake/wrap require balances and allowance to staking. gOHM unstake/unwrap burns directly from caller through staking authority, without caller gOHM allowance. gOHM mint/burn wiring and index remain dependency-authoritative; no current authorization/storage state attestation.

Warmup is configurable: stake only immediately delivers if _claim=true and warmupPeriod=0; otherwise records recipient warmup, accumulates gons and resets expiry. An account defaults to self-only warmup deposits/claims; stored lock=true actually enables external deposits/claims. toggleLock changes that authorization setting and is excluded. claim can return zero before maturity and does not itself advance epochs; forfeit returns original deposit and relinquishes gains.

stake invokes rebase; unstake optionally invokes it when _trigger=true. Rebase can call governor-configured distributor.distribute/retrieveBounty and dependencies can revert. A bounty, if any, is included in stake/unstake amount; standalone rebase maintenance is excluded. No current yield, distributor, bounty, warmup or epoch cadence is asserted.

Indexed gOHM conversions use floor division: balanceTo(amount)=amount*10^18/index and balanceFrom(amount)=amount*index/10^18. Small positive amounts may round to zero. No minimum-output/deadline argument exists; caller must choose intended recipient and manage index/rounding. Unstake checks available contract OHM; wrap/unwrap depend on sOHM inventory/mint-burn authority.

Only this Ethereum staking/wrapping interface is admitted. No V1 migration, bridge, governance vote/delegation, Cooler loan, treasury, distributor administration or arbitrary executor capability is included; gOHM governance/Cooler utility does not grant those functions.

functions.label: YieldFi Deposit configured base asset through yPrism vault
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only; not a fresh RPC/storage/runtime identity, balance, liquidity, pause-state, eligibility or successful-execution attestation. Exact grants, canonical calldata, pauses and independent controls still apply. All admitted calls are nonpayable and require zero native value.

Current Ethereum YieldFi V3 Manager proxy 0x08fB9833A5a84d5bCEcDF5a4a635d33260C5F05C resolves on Etherscan to 0x948005846961d0813AF1B18d0316214b4b83A2F2; yPrism proxy 0xdd5eff0756db08bad0ff16b66f88f506e7318894 resolves to 0xd3963b0Ae80081a98156fdFC286529c91a19F2Aa. Upgradeability and mutable registry/NAV/oracle/feature wiring remain authoritative.

This admission excludes paused legacy yUSD/vyUSD. Official site explicitly says V3 is live. Explorer read-as-proxy observation binds current yPrism asset() to PRISM 0x06Bb4ab600b7D22eB2c312f9bAbC22Be6a619046 (18 decimals), name() YieldFi OpenEden and manager() to reviewed V3 Manager: direct yPrism deposit therefore uses PRISM, NOT USDC. Official yPrism legal terms still describe USDC settlement and USDC/USDT/USD0 deposits; that document is not substituted for current on-chain configuration. Manager deposit amount uses selected whitelisted asset decimals; all vault shares use 18 decimals. Re-read registry/whitelist/base asset for the chosen vault before use.

Manager deposit pulls the chosen whitelisted asset from caller to registry-configured deposit recipient, prices it via NAV and (for non-base asset) configured oracle, applies fee/limits/greenlist checks, then mints net shares. Set minShares appropriately. bytes32 referralCode is emitted attribution data, not executable calldata. Registration and whitelist checks constrain caller-selected vault/asset to configured YieldFi products; no arbitrary executor is admitted.

Vault deposit pulls its configured base asset to vault, validates caller/receiver, and calls its Manager with minShares=0 and referralCode=0. Caller must approve the vault, while the vault must already have operator-provisioned Manager allowance. No caller-set slippage minimum or deadline exists on this wrapper. Manager direct deposit requires allowance to Manager instead. The wrapper becomes msg.sender in the downstream Manager deposit and may itself need configured greenlist eligibility; current provisioning is not attested.

requestRedemption is asynchronous: fees may be charged immediately and net shares are locked, not paid out. owner must have unlocked shares; if owner differs from caller, caller needs vault-share allowance (spender is caller, not Manager). Processing is onlyOperator and deliberately excluded: users cannot force completion, payment timing, gasFeeShares, NAV or redemption-source liquidity. Queue index comes from RedemptionRequested/nextQueueIndex, not transaction return value.

cancelRedemption unlocks remaining queued net shares; it does not refund already charged redemption fees or pay assets. Non-owner cancellation spends caller allowance against owner. It lacks global whenNotPaused but still checks vault pause, owner blacklist, registration and queue existence. No user claim/withdraw/redeem exists in the exact Vault implementation, despite generic SDK examples.

Redemption pricing uses current NAV or min(request,current NAV) if MIN_NAV feature enabled, deducts operator-supplied gasFeeShares and settles configured base asset from redemption source. yPrism terms state target T+2, not an on-chain guaranteed maturity; other registered vaults can have different terms. No deadline or caller-set redemption minimum is present. The observed yPrism base asset is PRISM rather than the USDC stated in legal terms; no claim that operator settlement currently pays USDC is made.

Global/vault pauses, blacklists, enabled greenlist/KYC and limits, initialized NAV, redemption enabled status and required allowances remain authoritative. Eligibility excludes U.S. Persons/United States and restricts UK, China and sanctioned jurisdictions; wallet permission does not establish legal eligibility. Instruments are subordinated limited-recourse contractual claims, not ownership of underlying assets.

functions.label: YieldBasis Deposit cbBTC with debt and minimum shares
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only; not a fresh RPC/storage/runtime identity, balance, liquidity, pause-state, eligibility or successful-execution attestation. Exact grants, canonical calldata, pauses and independent controls still apply. All admitted calls are nonpayable and require zero native value.

Only current Ethereum cbBTC LT 0x722FC3640BA007C3E9867CCdB0dCa59F2e2F29F9 is admitted; legacy/v2 markets, factory, LEVAMM, Curve pool, gauges, zaps and HybridVaults are not transaction targets in this admission. This is the exact Vyper LT interface, not generic ERC4626.

assets/min_assets are native cbBTC units (8 decimals); shares/min_shares are yb-cbBTC units (18 decimals). debt is crvUSD units (18 decimals) borrowed by the market from its allocation, not stablecoins transferred from depositor. Depositor needs cbBTC balance and allowance to LT.

Deposit requires an appropriate caller-chosen debt amount, available credit and AMM safety/debt limits; min_shares bounds net shares. withdraw burns caller-owned shares and settles market debt through fixed-output Curve removal; min_assets bounds cbBTC output. No caller-set deadline exists. Receiver must not be the configured staker; withdraw also forbids staker as caller.

Share supply/value can change through staker rebases, oracle/price-scale accounting, admin fee accounting, debt interest and borrower-fee distribution; positive small deposits can round to zero shares when min_shares is zero. Remaining total supply must be at least 10^6 share units unless fully withdrawn. Minimums must be chosen meaningfully.

Underlying pool, AMM/oracle, gauge checkpoint and fee-distribution dependencies can revert; ordinary withdraw rejects killed AMM. Kill state, credit allocation, fee/rate/staker/admin controls and current dependencies are not attested. Emergency exits have different dual-asset/crvUSD-funding semantics and are not admitted. No no-loss or financial-safety assurance is made.

No caller-set deadline exists. Receiver must not be the configured staker; withdraw also forbids staker as caller.

Share supply/value can change through staker rebases, oracle/price-scale accounting, admin fee accounting, debt interest and borrower-fee distribution; positive small deposits can round to zero shares when min_shares is zero. Remaining total supply must be at least 10^6 share units unless fully withdrawn. Minimums must be chosen meaningfully.

Underlying pool, AMM/oracle, gauge checkpoint and fee-distribution dependencies can revert; ordinary withdraw rejects killed AMM. Kill state, credit allocation, fee/rate/staker/admin controls and current dependencies are not attested. Emergency exits have different dual-asset/crvUSD-funding semantics and are not admitted. No no-loss or financial-safety assurance is made.

functions.label: Tharwa Begin cooldown for exact thUSD
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory, not fresh RPC bytecode/storage/configuration or successful-execution proof. Active catalog status is not a live executability assertion. Balances, allowances, gas, canonical calldata, grants, catalog pauses and all independent policies remain authoritative. All admitted calls are nonpayable; send zero native value.

Ethereum sThUSD is a direct sThUSD deployment, not a proxy. Underlying is 18-decimal thUSD 0x76972F054aB43829064d31fF5f3AcC5Fabe57FE8; shares inherit 18 decimals. Deposit/mint require caller thUSD allowance to this exact vault. This is real staking, not bare token transfer support, thUSD minting, USDC redemption, wthUSD or a bond product.

Cooldown mode is admin-configurable among 0, 3 days and 7 days. Constructor default is 0, not a verified live setting. withdraw/redeem are synchronous ONLY when cooldownPeriod==0. With cooldown on, cooldownAssets/cooldownShares burn caller shares and place the specified net thUSD in immutable ThUSDSilo; unstake(receiver) separately claims the full aggregated amount after maturity, or immediately if admin turns cooldown off.

Every additional cooldown request resets maturity on the ENTIRE accumulated per-caller amount. No partial claim or cancellation exists. Cooldown amount storage explicitly narrows to uint152 without a separate bounds check; callers must keep requested/accumulated raw amounts within that range. No claim is made that source enforces this business bound. Cooled thUSD is no longer represented by yield-bearing shares.

All staking/exit/claim paths are pause-gated. Vault blacklist restricts share from/to and withdrawal/claim receiver; the underlying thUSD independently blacklists transfers and approvals. No deposit KYC allowlist appears in reviewed vault source. Official compliance docs distinguish anonymous DeFi users from whitelisted market makers who mint/redeem thUSD at parity; primary issuance/redemption eligibility is NOT included or bypassed by this vault admission.

Entry/exit fees may each be 0..1000 bps (10%), admin-managed, and use ceiling math. previewDeposit removes inclusive entry fee; previewMint adds raw entry fee; previewWithdraw adds raw exit fee; previewRedeem removes inclusive exit fee. Fees are transferred to treasury unless it is zero or the vault; accounting still removes the fee in those cases. No current fee, treasury or pause value is attested.

No user minimum-output, maximum-input or deadline parameters. Virtual-share rounding and mutable fees can change amounts; small deposits may mint zero shares because this implementation adds no positive-share check. totalAssets uses internally accounted pooled assets minus unvested yield, not raw donations. Yield is supplied only by YIELD_MANAGER_ROLE and linearly recognized over configurable nonzero vestingPeriod (30-day constructor default).

The reviewed deployed ThUSDSilo withdraw uses raw underlying transfer without checking its returned bool; source admission does not assert successful payment for every token behavior. The source must be used over documentation snippets claiming nonReentrant or different silo deposit/accounting/fee logic: those snippets do not match this deployment. Current docs label sthUSD live; the product includes global interest-bearing strategies and is explicitly not currently Shariah-compliant. No backing, price, liquidity or complete USDC-to-yield-to-USDC workflow assurance.

functions.label: Wildcat Deposit (Wintermute WBTC)
warnings: Static exact-deployment ABI/source inventory, not a current RPC/runtime/storage identity or successful-execution guarantee. Canonical calldata, grants, pauses and independent execution controls remain mandatory; send zero native value.

Only Ethereum V2 Wintermute Trading Wrapped BTC market 0x33ac9b224c8a189d2332aecf021897f1535373ab is admitted; not deprecated V1, arbitrary borrowers, Plasma or all Wildcat markets. Explorer reports verified similar-match WildcatMarket; immutable constructor configuration differs among markets.

Underlying is WBTC 0x2260fac5e5542a773aa44fbcfedf7c193bc2c599 with 8 decimals, not BTC or USDC. Deposit consumes caller WBTC allowance and mints caller rebasing market tokens tracked in scaled units; depositUpTo may deposit less than requested at capacity. Rounding can reject tiny amounts; no caller-set min-share output or deadline.

Borrower-configured access hooks, credentials, minimum deposit, sanctions/sentinel and mutable SphereX protection can reject calls. Official indexed metadata observed minimumDeposit=1000000 WBTC base units and an open-term access hook, not a live eligibility or execution attestation. MLA/offchain eligibility obligations remain independent.

Withdrawal requests queue the caller market-token balance and return batch expiry; they are not immediate underlying withdrawals. The observed withdrawalBatchDuration is 86400 seconds, but funding can remain partial and delayed indefinitely until borrower repayment. executeWithdrawal(s) sends only allocated underlying to the named lender, never an arbitrary recipient; sanctioned lender proceeds go to escrow.

The deployed HooksConfig library forwards trailing non-ABI calldata as hook extraData. Only exact canonical ABI encodings are in scope, with no appended proof/provider payloads. Fixed immutable hook target is not a caller-selected executor. Batch executeWithdrawals explicitly forwards empty hook data; no generic multicall or authorization surface is admitted.

Credit exposure is undercollateralized; market tokens are borrower claims rather than proof of immediately available reserves. Borrower may adjust configured supply/rates within hook constraints; protocol fees and delinquency affect accounting. No balance, liquidity, rate, repayment or financial-safety assurance is implied.

functions.label: Multipli Deposit USDC for xUSDC
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity or execution guarantee. Balances, allowances, pauses, canonical calldata, grants and independent execution policies remain mandatory; all admitted calls require zero native value.

Ethereum xUSDC ERC1967/UUPS proxy 0x133229E0AdFf22c6F1AD287D199ea09d35E4427B is bound by official deployments and explorer to implementation 0x9921f41DF5A816Ff1940DbA35b8c394E4917667d. Owner/authority can upgrade, change external fee configuration, pause and manage reported strategy balances; no administration, executor, flash callback or bridge capabilities admitted.

Underlying is Ethereum USDC at 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 (6-decimal base units), not BSC USDC. xUSDC share units inherit underlying decimals with zero offset. Deposits/mints consume caller USDC allowance, require the mutable minimum deposit amount, and use operator-reported aggregate strategy balances plus vault cash for valuation. No fixed exchange rate, backing or yield is attested.

Both ordinary deposit/mint overloads are supported; third-argument deposit enforces minShares and third-argument mint enforces maxAssets. Two-argument forms lack a caller-set price bound, and none has a deadline. Mutable per-asset fee contract determines deposit and withdrawal fees; zero-fee FAQ copy is not a current configuration guarantee. Floor rounding can mint zero shares for small positive deposits; no current fee rate, minimum, cash balance or unpaused state has been inferred.

requestRedeem requires owner == msg.sender and positive owned xUSDC shares, transfers shares into the vault without share allowance and aggregates pending gross assets/shares by receiver. Request ID is always zero; receiver is an economically binding payout address and is not checked for zero here. No user cancellation, caller-set minimum net payout or on-chain fulfillment deadline exists.

Redemption is asynchronous operator fulfillment, not a user claim call: fulfillRedeem burns escrowed shares and pays receiver USDC minus then-applicable fees. Partial fulfillment is possible and relies on authorized operators and vault liquidity; official current Earn UI describes 7–14 day payout, not a contract-enforced guarantee. Direct withdraw/redeem always revert UseRequestRedeem and are excluded; requestInstantRedeem and cancelRedeem are authorized-only, not ordinary user alternatives.

Current live Earn UI explicitly offers Ethereum USDC → xUSDC deposit and sell-back. Older v2 FAQ says Avalanche-only; current deployment mapping and live interface supersede that network list. Legal terms restrict jurisdictions including US/Canada/sanctioned territories and may require compliance/KYC; permissionless user functions do not waive legal eligibility.

functions.label: Aegis Start sYUSD cooldown by YUSD amount
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity or execution guarantee. Balances, allowances, pauses, canonical calldata, grants and independent execution policies remain mandatory; all admitted calls require zero native value.

Ethereum sYUSD TransparentUpgradeableProxy 0xfE0ccc9942E98C963Fe6b4e5194EB6e3Baa4cb64 is currently reported by both Sourcify and explorer as implementation 0xb0c63bB1667b6e9215AEe562aF2957739B2676fE, not its initial implementation 0xd2188c292f294e5de506594a82a2fc683f27d08e. Proxy upgrades and role-controlled cooldown/fee/insurance changes remain possible.

Underlying is Ethereum YUSD at 0x4274cD7277C7bb0806Bd5FE84b9aDAE466a8DA0a, not USDC. YUSD and sYUSD use 18-decimal base units (zero vault decimals offset). Deposit/mint spend caller YUSD allowance; vault share value follows actual YUSD vault balance, rounding and donations, not a fixed 1:1 amount or guaranteed increasing rate. No admitted function provides a caller-set slippage bound or deadline. Floor rounding can mint zero shares for small positive deposits. Deployed YUSD checks owner-controlled sender/recipient blacklist status on every mint/burn/transfer, so deposits, exits and silo claims can revert under blacklist restrictions.

cooldownAssets/cooldownShares require positive input, owner == msg.sender and nonzero cooldownDuration. They immediately burn shares, transfer gross YUSD to the fixed silo and accumulate a caller-owned underlying claim. Each new cooldown resets the maturity for the entire accumulated claim; escrowed YUSD no longer earns vault-share accrual. Underlying claim storage casts to uint152, so values must fit that width; do not treat ABI uint256 as an unlimited claim balance.

unstake(receiver) releases the caller's entire accumulated silo claim after its recorded cooldownEnd, or immediately if governance has disabled cooldown; receiver must be nonzero. Ethereum JTRSY USDC AsyncVault 0xFE6920eB6C421f1179cA8c8d4170530CDBdfd77A is a direct deployment, not a generic ERC4626 interface or the separate Basin facility. Share token is JTRSY 0x8c213ee79581Ff4984583C6a801e5263418C4b86; underlying is native Ethereum USDC, both documented with 6 decimals. Vault managers and authorized wards are mutable; current manager storage/configuration is not attested.

JTRSY requires Anemoy onboarding/KYC/AML and wallet whitelisting before requests or receipt of restricted shares. The pinned official fund deck describes a BVI professional fund open to non-US Professional Investors, a $500,000 USDC investment minimum and 15 bps annual management fee plus passed-through third-party fees (with initial-investor waiver noted). These are published offering terms, not current onchain minima/fee configuration or an eligibility grant; confirm operative issuer terms.

requestDeposit escrows USDC immediately and needs owner==caller or an existing owner-approved operator plus USDC allowance to the vault. requestRedeem escrows JTRSY through the manager; the simplest documented owner/controller/receiver is the investor, with no share approval needed for an owner request. Every requestId is 0 and requests aggregate by controller. Operator/authorization creation is not admitted.

Deposit/mint and withdraw/redeem are CLAIMS against manager-fulfilled requests, not synchronous deposits or instant exits. Controller must be caller or an existing approved operator. Fulfillment is manager-driven with no fixed cadence or guaranteed exit timing; pending/claimable state and actual issuer settlement rules must be checked. The older pinned deck describes usually T+1 / no more than 7 US business days, while the later integration guide explicitly gives no fixed cadence; no contractual SLA is inferred.

Use mint(maxMint(controller),receiver,controller) to claim investment shares and withdraw(maxWithdraw(controller),receiver,controller) to claim redemption USDC to reduce rounding dust. deposit/redeem variants may leave dust; previewDeposit/previewMint/previewWithdraw/previewRedeem unconditionally revert. There are no caller min-output/max-input or deadline fields on the admitted calls; manager NAV, fund liquidity and transfer restrictions govern results.

Cancel functions submit asynchronous controller cancellation requests; they do not immediately return escrow. claimCancelDepositRequest/claimCancelRedeemRequest require the corresponding manager-claimable cancellation and return USDC/JTRSY respectively. The ABI requestId argument is ignored and documented as 0. Manager policy can reject or delay cancellation; completed fulfillment cannot be assumed cancellable. Basin instant exit, bridging, callbacks, admin and operator powers are excluded.

functions.label: Clearpool Deposit USDC for cpOLEA shares
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime configuration, KYC, liquidity, pause, rate, authority or successful-execution guarantee. Both admitted ordinary calls require zero native value; grants, canonical calldata and independent controls remain mandatory.

Clearpool Olea trade-finance vault on Ethereum is cpOLEA BoringVault 0xa3dbe1b752598f7f8d88caf415ff62b94d7c6d23, not the deprecated Dynamic V1 pools or unsupported-chain credit pools. Official current app metadata binds Teller 0xf6329c02c8ea0baa69c30d2ad4278762d8a72968 and AtomicQueue 0x446fa8a15aadce2896a3909dc68b9148b3dc0fcf. All reviewed contracts are direct deployments; no proxy interface substitution is used.

Olea is a KYC-required offering in the official active lending directory; onboarding contact in app configuration is legal@cicada.partners. Teller supports DISABLED / KEYRING_KYC / MANUAL_WHITELIST modes plus contract whitelist exceptions. deposit is also requiresAuth, so public-call authorization and account eligibility remain runtime requirements, not grants supplied by catalog admission. Clearpool regional/legal restrictions remain applicable.

Underlying/base asset is Ethereum USDC (6 decimals); cpOLEA shares have 6 decimals, while accountant rates use 18 decimals. deposit(asset,amount,minimumMint) checkpoints the accountant, applies asset pricing and cap, pulls assets through BoringVault from caller, and mints shares to caller. USDC must be approved to BoringVault, NOT to Teller. Supply a meaningful minimumMint; the public app uses zero, which is not a slippage recommendation. No caller deadline exists on deposit.

Share transfers may remain locked by Teller shareUnlockTime; new deposits reset that user unlock time. Governed shareLockPeriod is bounded by 3 days in reviewed source. Authorized refunder may revert eligible deposits during the recorded lock period; refundDeposit is privileged and not admitted. Accountant fees, asset support, cap, pause and authority settings remain mutable. Official observed UI quotes 0.50% management fee and 1,000,000-USDC maximum deposit; these are offchain UI observations, not fresh onchain state.

updateAtomicRequest(offer,want,deadline,offerAmount) only creates/replaces the caller's request for a token pair and transfers no tokens itself. Intended withdrawal pair is cpOLEA -> USDC. Keep shares in the wallet and approve AtomicQueue for their eventual transfer; requests can be made without sufficient balance/allowance but then cannot settle. Zero offerAmount cancels; updating a pair replaces its prior amount/deadline. No claim transaction is required after a solver transfers output directly to the requester.

Withdrawals are asynchronous solver-filled requests, not BoringVault instant exits. Observed Olea app terms show 30-day notice and 37-day total withdrawal deadline (30+7). The deployed AtomicQueue has only an expiry deadline, NOT an onchain earliest-fill notice check; those business terms are not guaranteed by updateAtomicRequest. Fill timing, eligible authorized solver, liquidity and payer transfers are not guaranteed; after expiry the request can no longer be filled unless updated.

AtomicQueue computes output at accountant.getRate() at solve time with decimal conversion/rounding; its request ABI has NO minPrice/minAssets/slippage bound, despite the event field named minPrice (emitted as 0). The caller-selected offer/want tokens are not pinned in updateAtomicRequest. Arbitrary solver/runData solve(), BoringVault manage(), administrative enter/exit, bulk solver flows, LayerZero bridge/callbacks and permit are all excluded; admission is not a complete-workflow or financial-safety assurance.

Official October 2026 CPOOL-to-CLEAR migration notice concerns governance-token migration and XRPL expansion; it is not treated as evidence that this currently ACTIVE Ethereum Olea offering is retired. No token-migration or XRPL capability is admitted.

functions.label: Anzen Request cooldown by USDz amount
warnings: Static deployed source/ABI inventory only, not a fresh RPC/storage/bytecode identity or successful-execution guarantee. Balances, allowances, canonical calldata, grants, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory. All admitted calls require zero native value.

Ethereum sUSDz is a direct SUSDz deployment, not the bridged sUSDz OFT or a proxy. Underlying is 18-decimal USDz 0xA469B7Ee9ee773642b3e93E842e5D9b5BaA10067, not USDC; deposit/mint require USDz allowance to this vault. Share units are 18-decimal sUSDz. No arbitrary executor, permit, role or bridge method admitted.

Cooldown mode is governed by mutable CDPeriod. CDAssets/CDShares require CDPeriod > 0, immediately burn caller shares and escrow USDz in immutable USDzFlat; they do not pay liquid USDz. Every new request resets the maturity of the entire accumulated caller cooldown balance. unstake() claims the entire stored balance to caller when matured, or immediately if CDPeriod becomes zero.

functions.label: Fusion by IPOR Deposit USDC assets
warnings: Static deployed ABI/source inventory only; not fresh RPC/storage/bytecode identity, liquidity, backing, financial-safety or successful-execution assurance. Underlying is 6-decimal Ethereum USDC 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48; PlasmaVault shares use underlying decimals plus offset 2 (8 decimals). deposit/mint pull USDC from caller with vault allowance; withdraw/redeem burn owner shares and require share allowance when caller differs from owner. Receiver is explicit.

All four ordinary methods are restricted by the current external authority; publicDepositOpened=true is the official API observation, not an authorization grant. Deposit/mint may reset caller redemption locks. Constructor authority 0x1dc356117aa5dcf8ce836aee851dafd04479ae8a has source-bound immutable redemption delay 0; authority can be replaced and no current authority storage check was made. Scheduling, target closure and roles remain authoritative.

No asynchronous request or claim method exists in this deployed vault. withdraw attempts configured instant-withdrawal fuses for requested assets plus 10 base units; redeem makes up to 10 attempts, targeting assets plus a fixed 2% buffer. Those buffers are not caller minimum-output guarantees. Insufficient realizable cash, fuse reverts, distribution limits, oracle behavior or authority can revert exits; maxWithdraw/maxRedeem only reflect accounting holdings, not available cash.

Management fee is annualized over gross assets and elapsed time, realized by minting fee-manager shares before all four selected methods; performance fee mints shares from recognized positive asset delta after market updates/exits. Constructor rates were 100/10000 (1%) management and 1000/10000 (10%) performance, not asserted current. Gross accounting includes cached market balances and optional rewards manager; current fees, fuses, price oracle and configuration may differ.

Deposit and redeem round down; mint and withdraw round up, using virtual assets +1 and virtual shares +100. Positive primary amount and nonzero receivers required. Supply cap applies. No caller-set deadline, min shares/assets or max input guard exists. Alpha execution, fuse payloads, callbacks, permits, voting and administration are excluded.

warnings: Static deployed ABI/source inventory only; not fresh RPC/storage/bytecode identity, liquidity, backing, financial-safety or successful-execution assurance. Exact grants, canonical calldata, balance/allowance, protocol access restrictions, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory. Underlying is 6-decimal Ethereum USDC 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48; vault shares also 6 decimals (underlying cached at initialization, zero offset). deposit/mint require USDC allowance to the vault; withdraw/redeem and in-kind exits require owner share balance and share allowance when caller is not owner. Outputs go to explicit receiver/recipient.

deposit/mint enforce capacity and whenNotPaused. withdraw/redeem are intentionally not whenNotPaused in the reviewed implementation. Transient transaction action lock prevents mixing deposit/mint with withdraw/redeem in one transaction; same-action repetition is not that prohibition. No depositor role/KYC check is present in these bodies; underlying restrictions, frontend terms and legal eligibility remain independent.

No async request/claim queue exists in this V2 ABI. Legacy supply/withdraw queue getters unconditionally revert. Ordinary cash exits withdraw from configured ERC4626 pool, or transfer idle USDC when no pool is configured; they do not automatically unwind curator orders. maxWithdraw/maxRedeem are owner-accounting bounds, not a liquidity promise; insufficient pool/idle cash reverts and curator adjustment or maturity settlement may be necessary.

withdrawFts is an in-kind exit, NOT a USDC cash claim: amount is the requested market FT face amount and is converted to burned vault shares with previewWithdraw rounding up. The fixed manager requires a registered nonzero order maturity mapping, obtains market FT through that order, and asks the order to transfer FT. No arbitrary target/payload or raw selector is accepted. FT maturity, order holdings and later redemption are independent; no FT trading/redemption capability is granted.

dealBadDebt burns owner shares priced by previewWithdraw(badDebtAmt) to receive pro-rata collateral from recorded vault bad debt, not USDC or guaranteed par value. collateral cannot equal asset; manager requires positive mapped bad debt and amount<=bad debt and computes floor(amount*collateralBalance/badDebt). No minimum collateral output or deadline exists, so small amounts can round to zero; token behavior, bad-debt accounting and recoverability remain risks.

Interest accrues linearly across order maturities, net of mutable curator performanceFeeRate, into accreting principal; totalAssets is that preview principal, not cash. Rate bounded by source constants; fees tracked separately and curator withdrawal excluded. Official current API reports performanceFeeRate=0 and timelock=86400 for this vault, not a live-storage guarantee. Idle base pool carries its own fees; official depositor guide describes an additional currently 2% protocol fee on passive idle yield, not principal. No fixed whole-vault all-in fee guarantee is made.

ERC4626 uses virtual +1 assets/+1 shares: deposit/redeem floor, mint/withdraw ceil. No caller slippage limits or deadline. Owner/curator can change markets, pool, capacity and fee configuration subject to asymmetric timelocks; guardian may pause. Clone targets fixed TermMaxVaultV2 implementation 0x9f1882FfBb007DD275C931ac302CfA97A4cEaa1D, which delegates only internally encoded operations to immutable OrderManagerV2 0xaec65f8f45b93e2de4cde40cbef9cac8e3345b41. No privileged order execution, callbacks, raw router or rebalance capability admitted.

functions.label: Asymmetry Finance Deposit CVX
warnings: Static deployed source/ABI inventory only, not fresh RPC/storage/runtime identity, liquidity/backing, successful-transaction or financial-safety assurance. Grants, canonical calldata/value checks, balances, allowances, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory; all admitted calls require zero native value.

Ethereum mainnet afCVX ERC1967 proxy 0x8668a15b7b023Dc77B372a740FCb8939E15257Cf currently resolves via Sourcify and Etherscan to AfCvx implementation 0x56664FFcCfF6BB282CcA96808AF03d9042e1f799, not stale official-doc implementation 0x87e670b71958d39113b7961dd016ec198ad82c03. Current implementation hardcodes 18-decimal CVX 0x4e3FBD56CD56c3e72c1403e103b45Db9da5B9D2B and afCVX shares are18 decimals. No safETH or legacy USDaf deployment is admitted.

deposit/mint pull caller CVX with allowance to afCVX and credit receiver shares; assets use CVX atoms, shares use afCVX atoms. withdraw/redeem pay explicit receiver and burn owner shares; non-owner caller needs existing share allowance. No permit, approval, transfer, arbitrary zap or role operation admitted.

Instant withdraw/redeem are cash- and shared-weeklyWithdrawalLimit-constrained and otherwise revert; no queue is created by these calls. They can unstake from fixed Convex RewardsPool if idle CVX is insufficient, but cannot instantly unlock the CLever portion. The remaining budget does not automatically refill merely because a week elapsed: operator/owner harvest calls _updateWeeklyWithdrawalLimit at/after withdrawalLimitNextUpdate, setting totalAssets*weeklyWithdrawalShareBps/10000 for another seven days.

Official guide advertises3% instant fee and25% weekly access, but actual withdrawalFeeBps/weeklyWithdrawalShareBps are owner-mutable and not asserted current. Fees are mathematically applied as gross-assets = requested-net-assets + ceil(net-assets*feeBps/10000); redeem subtracts ceil(gross*feeBps/(10000+feeBps)). Owner may configure withdrawal/performance fees or share splits up to10000bp. Fee remains accounted to vault holders; harvest performance fee is paid to protocolFeeCollector. Deposit/redeem conversions round down, mint/withdraw round up.

requestUnlock(shares,receiver,owner) burns shares immediately, needs share allowance if caller!=owner, books CVX obligations under receiver in the fixed CLever strategy and returns final unlock epoch plus assets. It is not an immediate payout and has no admitted cancellation. No afCVX withdrawal fee applies, but CLever repayment fees are reflected in strategy net accounting/unlock capacity. Requests can fail during strategy maintenance windows or unlockInProgress, or if capacity is insufficient.

withdrawUnlocked(receiver) is permissionless trigger of the matured requests already booked for that receiver; funds go to that same receiver, not caller. It cannot redirect another receiver claim. Claims scan matured weekly epochs (timestamp/one week), can return0 before maturity, and depend on actual strategy/CLever cash and successful locker withdrawal. Allocations across future unlock epochs and operator maintenance determine delay; no fixed instant settlement promise.

The afCVX implementation constructor immutably binds strategy proxy 0xB828a33aF42ab2e8908DfA8C2470850db7e4Fd2a, currently resolved to 0xD0F77441B70c84aa3366a9F79F2fD16618739aB0, not stale docs strategy implementation0x98f3f4ba1bbcd4fa3d7caf1eb88d93cd628cff02. Strategy constructor manager is afCVX proxy; requests/claims call only that manager. Vault and strategy remain owner-upgradeable and operator-managed, with mutable pause, fees, withdrawal share, allocation and operator settings. Paused blocks ordinary deposits and exits, including claims.

totalAssets includes idle CVX, Convex staked CVX and CLever strategy net assets after debt, repayment fee, fee-adjusted realized rewards and pending unlock obligations; it is not a cash-balance guarantee. Ordinary methods have no caller-set output minimum, max-input or deadline. CLever/Convex dependencies, rounding, mutable configuration and limited cash can affect execution.

No KYC proof/allowlist gate appears in these ordinary afCVX methods, but website terms require adult capacity and exclude US persons (including specified US residency/control connections), sanctioned/embargoed persons and unlawful jurisdictions. Contract ABI availability is not legal eligibility. uCVX/pxCVX migration, bridge, operator harvesting/distribution, governance and arbitrary zap execution are outside scope.

debond burns/transfers caller pPEAS and immediately returns proportional underlying to caller after fee, with downward rounding and no minimum output or deadline. removeLiquidityV2 pulls configured V2 LP tokens using allowance to pod, returns pPEAS and paired pfWETH-2 to caller through configured adapter with per-token minimums and deadline; lpTokens=0 consumes caller entire LP balance. functions.label: Teller Cancel own pending loan request
warnings: Static implementation/source inventory with dated read-only proxy/dependency observations, not future runtime identity, liquidity, financial-safety or execution assurance. Calls require zero native value and existing grants, canonical calldata, allowances, balances and independent controls.

Ethereum TellerV2 is the transparent proxy 0x00182FdB0B880eE24D428e3Cc39383717677C37e; applicable reported implementation is 0x37F483C895C66d3eDb14AE88ea9bA52F937Eb002, not constructor initial logic. Upgrade, market registry, collateral escrow, lender manager, pausing manager and reputation dependencies remain authoritative.

Principal and repayment amounts use each loan ERC20 lending-token raw units (not universally USDC); WETH stays ERC20, no native wrapping. APR is basis points (10000=100%). Duration is seconds; market-selected payment cycle, payment type, default period and bid expiration are captured per bid. Integer divisions round down; interest accrues using 360-day year for Monthly and 365 days for Seconds.

submitBid only records a pending loan request and optional collateral commitment, not guaranteed funding. Borrower must be market-verified and market open. Metadata URI is stored and hashed, not executed. Receiver zero resolves to borrower. Lender acceptance requires verified lender, nonclosed market, unexpired pending bid, lender principal allowance to TellerV2 and any borrower collateral allowances to CollateralManager.

Collateral tuple is (enum type, amount, tokenId, tokenAddress), supporting ERC20/ERC721/ERC1155, not arbitrary target+payload. Submitting collateral checks balances/ownership and records it; acceptance pulls collateral into escrow. ERC721 amount must be one; positive amounts are required when funding. Market borrower/lender verification may impose KYC, allowlists or jurisdiction eligibility; catalog access cannot satisfy those conditions.

Acceptance deducts protocol and marketplace fees from principal before receiver proceeds; both are basis-point floor divisions. Observed protocol fee was 5 bps at the recorded block, not a guaranteed future setting. Fee-on-transfer lending tokens are rejected by the exact receiver-balance-delta check. No max-fee, minimum net proceeds or caller deadline argument is supplied.

Repayment can be funded by any caller, not solely borrower, and pulls that caller lending tokens using allowance to TellerV2. Full/minimum amounts are computed at transaction time. Custom repay amount must cover minimum principal due plus interest. Do not overpay: _repayLoan caps only its local paymentAmount, while cumulative principal and _sendOrEscrowFunds still use the original Payment struct, so excess can be transferred/accounted rather than refunded.

Normal full repayment marks PAID and calls configured collateral manager withdrawal to the recorded borrower (not payer or lender). WithoutCollateralWithdraw variants leave collateral escrowed for a separate manager withdrawal not admitted here. Collateral-manager pause or transfer restrictions can revert normal full repayment; without-withdraw variants do not promise successful execution.

Repayment first attempts transferFrom to current lender (NFT owner after claimLoanNFT); failure routes funds via configured escrow vault for lender. A loan-specific lender-set repayment listener receives only fixed repayLoanCallback(bidId,payer,principal,interest) at zero native value and capped gas; callback failure is ignored but minimum gas check can revert. This is not caller-supplied arbitrary callback calldata or a callback setter capability.

claimLoanNFT requires the recorded direct lender and an accepted loan; it registers the loan with lender manager and makes NFT ownership determine future lender. No NFT transfer/approval, forwarder authorization, listener setter, arbitrary executor, liquidation or admin capability is admitted. Direct smart-wallet calls use their own caller identity; ERC2771 and market forwarder suffix identities do not grant impersonation through canonical catalog calls.

submitBid, lenderAcceptBid and claimLoanNFT require protocol unpaused. Cancellation and repayment do not have that top-level modifier, but dependencies can still pause/revert. Loan funds are committed for loan terms; this is direct loan-book funding, not an instantly redeemable pooled vault. Source says borrower receives collateral; an older withdraw documentation sentence saying lender is not substituted for actual implementation.

warnings: Static implementation/source inventory with dated read-only proxy/dependency observations, not future runtime identity, liquidity, financial-safety or execution assurance. Calls require zero native value and existing grants, canonical calldata, allowances, balances and independent controls.

Ethereum TellerV2 is the transparent proxy 0x00182FdB0B880eE24D428e3Cc39383717677C37e; applicable reported implementation is 0x37F483C895C66d3eDb14AE88ea9bA52F937Eb002, not constructor initial logic. Upgrade, market registry, collateral escrow, lender manager, pausing manager and reputation dependencies remain authoritative.

Principal and repayment amounts use each loan ERC20 lending-token raw units (not universally USDC); WETH stays ERC20, no native wrapping. APR is basis points (10000=100%). Duration is seconds; market-selected payment cycle, payment type, default period and bid expiration are captured per bid. Integer divisions round down; interest accrues using 360-day year for Monthly and 365 days for Seconds.

submitBid only records a pending loan request and optional collateral commitment, not guaranteed funding. Borrower must be market-verified and market open. Metadata URI is stored and hashed, not executed. Receiver zero resolves to borrower. Lender acceptance requires verified lender, nonclosed market, unexpired pending bid, lender principal allowance to TellerV2 and any borrower collateral allowances to CollateralManager.

Collateral tuple is (enum type, amount, tokenId, tokenAddress), supporting ERC20/ERC721/ERC1155, not arbitrary target+payload. Submitting collateral checks balances/ownership and records it; acceptance pulls collateral into escrow. ERC721 amount must be one; positive amounts are required when funding. Market borrower/lender verification may impose KYC, allowlists or jurisdiction eligibility; catalog access cannot satisfy those conditions.

Acceptance deducts protocol and marketplace fees from principal before receiver proceeds; both are basis-point floor divisions. Observed protocol fee was 5 bps at the recorded block, not a guaranteed future setting. Fee-on-transfer lending tokens are rejected by the exact receiver-balance-delta check. No max-fee, minimum net proceeds or caller deadline argument is supplied.

Repayment can be funded by any caller, not solely borrower, and pulls that caller lending tokens using allowance to TellerV2. Full/minimum amounts are computed at transaction time. Custom repay amount must cover minimum principal due plus interest. Do not overpay: _repayLoan caps only its local paymentAmount, while cumulative principal and _sendOrEscrowFunds still use the original Payment struct, so excess can be transferred/accounted rather than refunded.

Normal full repayment marks PAID and calls configured collateral manager withdrawal to the recorded borrower (not payer or lender). WithoutCollateralWithdraw variants leave collateral escrowed for a separate manager withdrawal not admitted here. Collateral-manager pause or transfer restrictions can revert normal full repayment; without-withdraw variants do not promise successful execution.

Repayment first attempts transferFrom to current lender (NFT owner after claimLoanNFT); failure routes funds via configured escrow vault for lender. A loan-specific lender-set repayment listener receives only fixed repayLoanCallback(bidId,payer,principal,interest) at zero native value and capped gas; callback failure is ignored but minimum gas check can revert. This is not caller-supplied arbitrary callback calldata or a callback setter capability.

claimLoanNFT requires the recorded direct lender and an accepted loan; it registers the loan with lender manager and makes NFT ownership determine future lender. No NFT transfer/approval, forwarder authorization, listener setter, arbitrary executor, liquidation or admin capability is admitted. Direct smart-wallet calls use their own caller identity; ERC2771 and market forwarder suffix identities do not grant impersonation through canonical catalog calls.

submitBid, lenderAcceptBid and claimLoanNFT require protocol unpaused. Cancellation and repayment do not have that top-level modifier, but dependencies can still pause/revert. Source says borrower receives collateral; an older withdraw documentation sentence saying lender is not substituted for actual implementation.

functions.label: Yelay Deposit USDC into project
warnings: Static deployed ABI/source inventory plus dated read-only selector observations, not future runtime identity or successful-execution, liquidity, backing or financial-safety assurance. Current observed deposit/redeem/migratePosition routes resolve to FundsFacet 0xce0dE4c16cD7734202939BbeB03905cB750c6901 at recorded block. Sourcify does not detect the custom selector routing and reports this custom-router deployment as isProxy:false; verified vault source establishes delegate routing. Underlying getter at the recorded block returned Ethereum 6-decimal USDC 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48. Assets and ERC1155 share amounts are raw units, not human currency amounts or ordinary ERC4626 ERC20 shares. Supply spans project IDs; deposit requires USDC allowance to the vault and an active client project ID; shares are minted to explicit receiver.

Deposit and redeem accrue all positive strategy interest as new project-0 yield shares held by configured YieldExtractor. User project shares principally represent capital; separately distributed yield claims, Merkle proofs and transform/claim paths are not admitted here. Project/client fee distribution is external to this bounded vault-function inventory, not guaranteed automatic compounding to this caller.

Conversion floors assets*totalSupply/totalAssets (initial deposit uses 1:1 units); no min shares, min assets, max loss or deadline argument protects the transaction. A small deposit can mint zero shares. Deposits try configured deposit-queue strategy adapters by delegatecall with fixed deposit(assets,supplement); if none succeeds, underlying is held internally. Callers cannot provide the adapter, supplement or arbitrary payload in admitted functions.

Redeem burns only msg.sender project shares, with no delegated owner argument or operator allowance path; receiver may differ. It computes assets after fee accrual, requires assets > 10 raw underlying units, and tries configured withdrawal queue. WITHDRAW_MARGIN=10 permits up to 10 raw units of shortfall/normalization; insufficient internal funds reverts. Strategy liquidity, queues and valuation can delay or prevent cash exit even though no user cooldown/withdrawal queue is encoded.

migratePosition burns caller shares and mints equal shares in a different active project under the same client; both IDs must be active and different. It does not move cash or bridge chains. Receiver ERC1155 hooks may revert deposits/migrations. No arbitrary multicall, swap, management/role, approval, token-transfer callback or reward-maintenance entry is admitted.

Each user function checks its own selector pause flag; authority can pause individual calls. Strategies/adapters, queues, client/project activation, role holders, YieldExtractor and selector mappings remain mutable. Official current SDK setup says new client activations are not being accepted; this admission covers ordinary existing active-project vault interactions, not new onboarding or legal eligibility.

Yelay is counted once, including former Spool continuity; no legacy Spool vault/deployment is admitted. Current website offers live yield infrastructure and current docs/repository map this vault. No TVL, usage, APY, performance or whole-workflow assurance is made.

Exact callback entrypoints remain excluded and this is not whole-workflow/security assurance.

This is the maintained Ethereum wstETH Fund, not the qETH/WETH or eQUEEN funds whose retirement is explicitly documented. Underlying is 18-decimal wstETH 0x7f39C581F595B53c5cb19bD0b3f8dA6c935E2Ca0; needWrap=true instead spends 18-decimal rebasing stETH 0xae7ab96520DE3A18E5e111B5EaAb095312D7fE84. QUEEN/staYETH/turYETH quantities are tranche base units, not raw ETH.

Router create/createAndSplit transfer the specified underlying from msg.sender using token allowance to the router. needWrap=true wraps transferred stETH through fixed wstETH; otherwise transfers wstETH directly. No payable ETH staking or native-ETH payout is admitted. Source primaryMarket.create consumes the entire unreserved primary-market underlying balance, not only this caller's input; prefunding standalone creation/buy/sell paths are excluded.

Direct primary-market split/merge/redeem/queueRedemption burn msg.sender tranche balances via the fund without ERC20 share allowance or a delegated owner argument; fund requires current rebalance version. A router call to createAndSplit burns router-created QUEEN atomically. Split ratio, NAV, rounding, fees and rebalance state determine tranche results; split/merge have no caller min-output or deadline.

Redeem and redeemAndUnwrapWstETH require immutable redemptionFlag and enough fund underlying to satisfy all queued redemptions first. queueRedemption burns QUEEN immediately and fixes an underlying claim, not immediate payment; claims require increasing unique indices belonging to account and sufficient liquidity to pop all earlier queue entries. Anyone can trigger a claim but proceeds always go to the recorded account, including fixed wstETH unwrapping to stETH. No fixed claim delay or payment guarantee.

Creation/redeem conversion floors at underlying/share exchange rate; exact-output quote helpers can round and are not transaction guarantees. Redemption and merge fee rates are owner-mutable, source-capped at 1%; explorer snapshot reported both zero, redemptionFlag=true and fund frozen=false on observation. These are point-in-time explorer values, not persistent runtime state. Fund owner may change primaryMarket/strategy after a proposal delay and may replace oracles; source initial strategy is zero. Annual settlementPeriod=31536000 is a recurring accounting period, not an expired individual loan.

The official disclaimer limits website use to professional/accredited/sophisticated investors rather than retail and prohibits unlawful jurisdictional offers; ABI permissionlessness does not waive legal eligibility. This bounded source inventory does not establish KYC status or investor suitability.

Deposit and redeem round down; mint and withdraw round up, and zero-result conversions revert. Accounting uses tracked totalAssets and profit-unlocked supply, not raw balance alone. Vault has no single user maturity or guaranteed lock duration. Strategy removes completed auction offers and redeems matured repo tokens during user funding/freeing/reporting, deposits excess underlying into its constructor-bound Yearn asset vault, and withdraws that vault for liquidity. Nonmatured loans cannot be demanded back; availableWithdrawLimit is loose asset plus min(assetVault converted balance, executable maxWithdraw). Insufficient liquidity, loan defaults, Yearn limits and upstream servicing may block exits or cause loss; no delayed claim token/queue call is admitted.

warnings: Static deployment-bound source/ABI inventory only. No current runtime identity, balances, funding, backing, liquidity, execution, complete-workflow or financial-safety guarantee. Calls require zero native value and independent exact-function grants, pause and canonical-calldata controls.

Amounts are ZCHF 18-decimal base units, underlying 0xB58E61C3098d85632Df34EecfB899A1Ed80921cB. save adds an amount, whereas adjust targets the caller saved balance after collecting interest. Deposits pull ZCHF from caller using allowance to this exact module; save(address,uint192) credits the named owner, not necessarily the payer.

This is referral-enabled Ethereum Savings, not legacy SavingsV2 0x3BF301B0e2003E75A3e86AB82bD1EFF6A9dFB2aE. New deposits have a weighted three-day interest delay; deployed withdraw has no ticks-based FundsLocked check despite a stale introductory source comment/error declaration. Interest delay is not a principal withdrawal lock here.

withdraw(address,uint192) spends only caller savings, pays the specified target and caps requested amount to refreshed available savings; requesting the full balance deletes the account including referral settings. Referral withdraw(uint192,address,uint24) pays caller then sets the supplied referral terms. No owner delegation or share allowance is used for savings withdrawal.

save/adjust/withdraw referral overloads first settle accrued interest under the previous referral terms, then set the new referrer/fee. Fee is parts per million of interest, at most 250000 (25%), not a principal fee. Non-referral overloads preserve existing terms unless a full withdrawal deletes the account; dropReferrer settles prior fees then clears future referral deductions.

Interest uses integer floor division by 1000000 and 365 days, accrues simply until refreshed into saved principal, and depends on governance-mutable rate plus ZCHF.coverLoss and reserve behavior. refreshBalance(address) can be called by others but credits the named savings owner and its stored referrer; it does not redirect principal. No caller deadline, minimum interest or minimum withdrawal-output guard.

Deposits revert when currentRatePPM is zero; the reviewed implementation does not enforce the commented proposed-future-zero-rate condition. A zero deposit into an empty account divides by zero. Rate, minter authorization, dependencies, available funds and current disabled state are not attested. Savings source has no onchain KYC/allowlist gate; token possession and legal/site eligibility remain separate responsibilities.

warnings: Static exact-deployment ABI/source inventory only; no runtime identity, execution, liquidity, funding, complete-workflow or financial-safety assurance. Independent grants, pause checks and canonical-calldata controls remain mandatory.

Only Ethereum Jones AURA Router proxy 0xf01dD67Ed9006f13F79ba9DE1a370864ad92b449 is callable. Source-service current implementation is 0x86A757c4a17b5758B745120a3F9bD6dc0Dc9BC27; do not use the old two-argument withdrawRequest interface bundled with the vault deployment. No leveraged GLP router, swapper or bridge is admitted.

Underlying is 18-decimal AURA 0xC0c293ce456fF0ED870ADd98a0828Dd4d2903DBF. deposit spends caller AURA via allowance to this router, transferring it directly to configured strategy atomically. tokenized=true mints 18-decimal wjAURA to caller; false records nontransferable virtual shares for caller. Share conversion floors and a positive deposit can produce zero shares; no minimum-shares/deadline argument exists.

withdrawRequest burns caller real or virtual shares immediately and fixes an AURA-denominated request, not a payout. For ordinary non-whitelisted callers _receiver is ignored and claim ownership stays with caller; whitelisted tokenized callers may assign the claim to _receiver. No separate vault-share approval is used for router-authorized burns. A new request updates the last-request timestamp for the entire recorded bucket.

withdraw takes AURA base units, requires caller recorded requests and current MIN_WITHDRAW_PERIOD since last request, and pays net AURA only to caller through configured strategy. Current explorer snapshot reports 1209600 seconds (14 days), MIN_DEPOSIT_PERIOD=0 and paused=false.
