Official current deployment register identifies this exact Polygon vault; own Vault and AsyncWithdraw source/ABIs are preserved with exact_match labels.

Vault 0x3f48e00cfeba3e713db8bc3e28d634578c553e32 and current withdrawal module 0xdc7bcfd0022ca1b0abbb87a1de8fdb83f1a0b58c are nonproxy deployments. Treasury can replace modules and lock deposits. Current observed valuation module is 0xe9e02e486995d92f877f7a6e8566285ef8763bad; auth, fee and cross-chain module addresses were zero. Separate latest configuration reads are not atomic or future-state guarantees.

deposit/assets and mint/shares pull native Polygon USDC 0x3c499c542cef5e3811e1192ce70d8cc03d5c3359 from caller using allowance to Vault directly into treasury 0x53b4dbdbc9861a626c62de557ed4f1560ffa3822; shares mint to chosen receiver. No prefunding, transfer capability, bridge, arbitrary target/selector or payload is admitted. Receiver is an economic beneficiary, not automatically caller-bound.

Amounts use 6-decimal asset/share base units. Actual inherited OpenZeppelin v5 conversions use totalSupply+1 and totalAssets+1; deposit rounds shares down, mint rounds assets up. No minimum-shares, maximum-assets or deadline argument exists. totalAssets uses configured valuation less accrued fees, not onchain proof of treasury backing; GlobalPriceValuation permits treasury-set portfolioValue and updates it proportionally to supply. Values and strategy exposures are not attested.

Deposits check lockDeposit and, when configured, authModule.authenticate(receiver), then accrue configured fees and update valuation. No auth or fee module was configured at observation, but this is not a grant of legal/app eligibility or a promise those modules remain disabled. Treasury and configured dependencies can change applicable restrictions and valuation.

Current asynchronous exits use module requestRedeem(shares,receiver,owner), not Vault.requestRedeem (module-only) or direct ERC4626 withdraw/redeem (revert for direct callers while module configured). Request moves owner shares to fixed pending keeper 0xd80e95c245537b094d5a59dba49c0eee52dc78bf; delegated callers need preexisting owner-to-caller share allowance. No delegation/approval authority is added. Receiver intentionally controls eventual payout and cancellation return; receiver need not equal owner.

Request requires open epoch and owner balance; it may automatically claim older receiver requests before adding new shares. decreaseRedeemRequest returns pending shares to msg.sender (the recorded receiver), and is allowed only while open for that receiver's current epoch request. Existing configured auth rules can also affect return transfers. It does not change roles or cancel another receiver's request.

claimRedeemRequest(receiver) is permissionless settlement only to recorded receiver, pulling underlying from fixed claimable keeper 0xd8272cbabc0a7dbb21cfde2f0faf672a67a0ce20. Treasury alone closes/opens epochs, supplies cash and chooses fulfilled shares; partial fulfillment and two stages of floor rounding apply. No timestamp-based settlement guarantee is encoded. The claim loop stops at a zero-rounded share epoch but advances stored requestId to current epoch, so do not equate aggregate view previews with successful payout across skipped or zero-rounded epochs. No assured payout amount or availability.

Cross-chain forceMint, module configuration, fee claims, forceBurn, epoch governance, ERC20 approvals/transfers and every read-only ABI function remain unselected. This admission adds ordinary direct deposit/mint and existing queued exit mechanics only.

Upgradeable aprMON proxy 0x0c65A0BC65a5D819235B71F554D210D3F80E0852 is bound by Monadscan to current reported implementation 0x7D2F8dc5a67CA1911bb1A2429552CDf507d106F2. Upgrades and owner-selected oracle, staking precompile, validators and fee vault can change behavior; no persistence assertion.

Underlying is native MON (18-decimal wei), represented by Eeeee native-asset sentinel, not WMON/ERC20. deposit requires msg.value exactly equal assets and assets strictly greater than 1000000000 wei; issues non-rebasing aprMON shares to receiver. mint rounds required native assets upward, requires msg.value >= assets, and refunds surplus to caller with an empty-data native call which can revert if caller rejects it. No underlying approval is needed.

requestRedeem moves owner aprMON shares into vault escrow and snapshots MON assets; it does not pay MON. Caller must be owner or an already authorized owner operator; ERC20 allowance alone is insufficient. Controller receives claim authority and need not equal owner; choose intentionally. MinimumRedeem is measured in MON asset wei; each controller has a bounded request-slot array.

redeem takes request IDs, not a share quantity; caller must be controller or its preauthorized operator while unpaused. When paused only oracleOperator can redeem, so user exits can be frozen. Each batch must already be oracle processed after staking/precompile unlock epochs; wall-clock estimates are not guaranteed and no cancellation function is present. Nonpayable requestRedeem/redeem require zero native value.

Withdrawal fee is charged at claim using then-current owner-configured withdrawalFee / 10000, including on existing requests; setter allows up to 10000 (100%). Reward fee uses percent denominator100 and is owner mutable. No caller-set min shares, max fee, min net redemption or deadline exists. Native receiver payout uses empty calldata and can revert; all IDs in one redeem are atomic.

previewWithdraw/maxWithdraw getters do not establish a synchronous withdraw function or immediately available liquidity. Conversion uses totalSupply minus burnableShares and oracle/staking accounting; floor/ceiling rounding and stale/ordered oracle updates affect amounts. No backing, rewards, valuation, liquidity, validator performance or financial-safety guarantee.

RequestUnlock consumes caller sMON shares with an internal transfer: no vault allowance required. It records an after-exit-fee MON spotValue immediately; minSpotValue bounds that recorded amount, not time to liquidity. Exit fee rounds up in shares and can be adjusted by fee role up to 50 bps; recorded fee exemption and rate apply at request. Annual management fee dilution is mutable up to 200 bps. Initial rates are not current rates.

Exit is asynchronous. Batch must be submitted by a separate protocol/community action; redeem requires current epoch >= batch activationEpoch + 1 on mainnet and enough liquid MON. Sweep/validator withdrawals may be required first; redeem itself does not sweep automatically. Batch timing, undelegation dust, paused state, validator/precompile and native receiver failure can delay/revert exits.

Cancel only while request.batchId equals currentBatchId. Cancel and redeem swap-and-pop the user request array: indices can change; re-read current unlock request before acting. Receiver must accept a native MON transfer. All four user paths are whenNotPaused. No KYC/allowlist guard is present in these paths; runtime state and legal eligibility are not attested.

Older official third-party guide is stale: it describes mint, requestUnlock(uint96), timestamp cooldown, sendBatchUnlockRequests and automatic sweep, none matching current implementation. Only the current exact implementation ABI/source controls admission. Excludes node/fee/role/upgrade administration, transfers/approvals, contribution donations, getDelegator precompile wrapper and compound/submitBatch/sweep maintenance; no arbitrary executor/multicall admitted.

Native depositMON/depositMONGVault spend msg.value in native MON (18-decimal wei units), not ETH. deposit/depositWMON/depositWMONGVault and mint use WMON allowance to gMON; initial proxy deployment bound WMON 0x3bd359C1119dA7DA1D913d1C4D2B7c461115433A. Nonpayable calls require zero native value. Shares are 18-decimal gMON; no caller-set minShares/maxAssets, output minimum or deadline exists.

requestRedeem/requestRedeemGVault immediately burn nonzero shares and initiate asynchronous native staking undelegation. Caller must be share owner or an already approved operator; ERC20 share allowance alone is insufficient. Nonzero controller required; only one active request per owner. Capture returned/emitted requestId; requests do not continue earning vault yield. No cancellation entry is admitted or present.

redeem(uint256,address,address) is a claim by requestId, NOT standard ERC4626 share redemption. redeem pays WMON; redeemMON pays native MON. Stored claimableTime must be reached AND underlying Monad undelegation epochs/withdrawal IDs must be ready; frontend ~12-hour wait is not a guaranteed deadline. Controller, owner, either approved operator, or protocol owner may claim to the specified receiver.

Actual withdrawn MON minus current withdrawal fee is paid; slashing, validator cash and fees can reduce output. If withdrawal is below request.assets, implementation may mint residual gMON to receiver to socialize losses; it does not simply enforce a min(request-time,current-value) payout clamp despite its source comment. withdrawalFee/rewardsFee are mutable basis points up to10000 (100%). Native-output receiver must accept empty-calldata MON transfer.

gVault variants use explicit uint64 validator IDs and fixed delegate/undelegate methods, not arbitrary target/calldata. Validator whitelist/status/pause, relative/absolute caps, minimum deposit/withdrawal, existing per-validator ownership accounting and rebalances can restrict calls. gMON transferability does not transfer gVault per-user validator allocation; transferred shares may require pooled redemption instead.

CoreVault and gVault use mutable staking dependencies and cached delegation accounting. Cache refreshes and reward-claim guards occur inside ordinary calls; current pauses, minimums, caps, fees, stake capacity and runtime eligibility were not read. requestUnstake burns caller nonzero uncommitted shares immediately and fixes a floor-rounded MON liability using recent-revenue-adjusted exchange rate; requests no longer earn rewards. Same completion epochs merge into up to seven pending buckets plus matured bucket. completionEpoch uses internal protocol epochs, normally native withdrawal delay plus four, with two additional epochs when global redemption capacity is insufficient.

completeUnstake pays every matured caller request directly to caller, leaving later requests queued. Completion requires internal epoch advancement/crank progress and sufficient redemption reserves or atomic-liquidity shortfall coverage; maturity is not a cash or wall-clock guarantee. No request ID, arbitrary receiver, operator approval or cancellation is accepted by these two pooled functions.

Closed mode blocks deposit/mint and traditional request/completion; atomic exits are not closed-gated but remain liquidity/circuit-breaker constrained. Share conversion uses virtual +1 assets/shares with floor deposit/redeem and ceil mint/withdraw rounding; recent revenue is included on entry but excluded on exit, so immediate round trips can lose value. Plain deposit/mint can fund any receiver without posting collateral. depositAsCollateral requires caller=receiver or an approved PositionManager; its For variant requires existing cToken delegate approval. postCollateral/removeCollateral operate on caller shares; For variants use existing delegate approval. withdraw/redeem and collateral-forcing variants burn owner shares and pay explicit receiver; non-owner calls need share allowance. redeemFor/redeemCollateralFor instead require existing delegate approval. Collateral/debt health, oracle checks and current market caps remain authoritative; posting collateral cannot be used while this account has debt in this same cToken, and borrowing cannot be used while it has collateral posted in this same cToken.

borrow attributes debt to caller and sends USDC to receiver; borrowFor needs existing owner delegate approval, not ERC20 allowance. repayFor can fund another owner without delegation. repay(0)/repayFor(0,owner) mean full accrued outstanding debt; positive excess repayment reverts. Borrow/post-collateral resets account cooldown; current manager source enforces 20-minute minimum hold on repayments and collateral-reducing actions, not a guaranteed immediately executable exit.

Exits are synchronous only when enough actual USDC cash is held; otherwise they revert, with no redemption queue or claim capability. Interest accrual occurs before ordinary calls; accounting includes vested interest, outstanding debt and protocol interest fee rather than treating wallet cash as totalAssets. No caller-set minimum shares/output, maximum assets/rate or deadline exists. Deposit/redeem round down; mint/withdraw round up; zero-result financial amounts revert.

functions.label: Atlantis swap exact input
warnings: Static deployment-bound source and ABI inventory only; not a fresh runtime identity, configuration, balance, liquidity, funding, successful-execution or financial-safety guarantee. Exact grants, canonical calldata/value checks, pauses and all independent execution controls remain mandatory.

Chain143 is Monad mainnet. Direct SwapRouter (not a proxy); verified constructor binds factory 0x10253594a832f967994b44f33411940533302acb, poolDeployer 0xd7cb0e0692f2d55a17ba81c1fe5501d66774fc4a and WNativeToken/WMON 0x3bd359c1119da7da1d913d1c4d2b7c461115433a. ETH-like payable value means native MON, not ETH.

Tokens, amounts, recipient, pool key/deployer, slippage and deadline are caller financial parameters. ERC20 inputs require allowance to this router. A nonzero intended recipient should be used: zero sends output to the router. No withdrawal/sweep/unwrap/refund helper or multicall is admitted, so these standalone swaps do not provide atomic native-output unwrapping or safe recovery of residual native value.

Payment uses router native balance first when input is WMON and balance covers the callback; otherwise it pulls ERC20 from the payer. Overpayment and partial-fill native-input swaps can strand value; residual balance is publicly refundable by excluded helper. Prefer WMON ERC20 input with zero native value for standalone calls; do not send unrelated value.

Path bytes are tokenA(20 bytes), custom deployer(20 bytes), tokenB(20 bytes), repeating deployer+token segments. Exact output reverses the path. Deployer is a financial pool-key salt component, not a call target: targets are CREATE2-derived under immutable poolDeployer and deployed init-code hash; callbacks verify that derivation. Source does not enforce exact path length, and trailing bytes may be ignored; no custom payload/aggregator execution is admitted.

Pool/plugin fees, liquidity and token transfer behavior determine outcomes. The fee-on-transfer variant calls swapWithPaymentInAdvance and compares pool-reported output, not necessarily recipient net taxed-token receipts. A nonzero exact-output single price limit permits less than requested output; source requires full output only with limitSqrtPrice zero.

functions.label: Bean Exchange addLiquidity
warnings: Static exact-deployment source/ABI inventory only, not fresh RPC, storage, runtime identity, liquidity, successful execution or financial-safety attestation. Exact-function grants, canonical calldata/value checks, pauses, balances, allowances and independent controls remain mandatory.

Monad mainnet chain143 native currency is MON, not ETH. Constructor binds factory 0x8Bb9727Ca742C146563DccBAFb9308A234e1d242 and WMON 0x3bd359C1119dA7DA1D913d1C4D2B7c461115433A. Native input uses msg.value; nonpayable calls require zero native value. Token amounts use each token's raw decimals; bin liquidity amounts are per-bin LB share units.

Paths are explicit pairBinSteps and tokenPath arrays. Router obtains each pair from its immutable factory and invokes fixed swap(bool,address); no arbitrary target/calldata, permit, multicall or executor admitted. Factory-selected pair implementations and configurable hooks/fees are external dependencies, not caller-controlled executor payloads.

ERC20 inputs require allowance to this router. Removal burns msg.sender's per-bin positions and requires existing pair approveForAll(router,true), sufficient unlocked balances and matching ids/amounts. Authorization changes themselves are excluded. LP recipient and refundTo are independent; excess native liquidity is refunded as WMON by pair mint, not automatically native MON.

LiquidityParameters includes lockUntil: adding liquidity can lock the recipient's entire existing position in affected bins until a later timestamp. Locked shares cannot burn or transfer; source lock extension applies only when later than stored lock. Distribution entries are cast to uint64 before encoding and validated downstream; callers must choose coherent token ordering, bins, distributions, activeIdDesired/idSlippage, minimums, recipient and deadline. No minimum minted-LP-share argument exists.

Swaps enforce deadlines and min-output or max-input. Exact-output calculation narrows requested intermediate amounts to uint128; oversized inputs can truncate before downstream checks and are not automatically financially validated. Native exact-output refunds unused msg.value to caller, which must accept MON. Native recipients must accept empty-calldata transfers.

Fee-supporting exact-input swaps measure recipient output balance deltas (or router WMON delta for native output), not whole pre-existing router balance. Standard swap/minimum and liquidity removal checks use reported gross amounts and do not guarantee net fee-on-transfer receipts. removeLiquidityNATIVE explicitly does not support transfer-tax tokens. Dynamic swap/composition fees, integer rounding and factory-configurable pair hooks can affect output or revert calls.

Router is direct nonproxy; no current pool configuration or hook storage read is claimed. No caller KYC/role gate is present in reviewed ordinary router entries; interface/legal eligibility is not attested.

Base yoUSD proxy uses explorer- and Sourcify-reported implementation 0xc84a6E01BFF58996540F1ABC22355A9DFE0d78DC. Upgrades, oracle pricing, fee recipient/rates, authority and pause state may change; current configuration is not attested.

Underlying is Base native USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 with 6 decimals; yoUSD shares also use 6 decimals. deposit consumes exact gross USDC and mint requests exact yoUSD shares; caller needs USDC allowance to the vault. redeem and requestRedeem have identical instant-or-queued semantics: owner MUST equal msg.sender, shares > 0, receiver must be nonzero and not vault. No separate user claim or user cancellation exists.

Queued redemptions require authorized fulfillment, which may be partial and can settle at request-time gross or a lower current-price value after exceptional losses. Live withdrawal fee applies when paid; original owner cannot cancel and privileged cancellation returns shares to receiver, not necessarily original owner. Documentation up-to-24-hour timing is not enforced or guaranteed.

Deposit/mint/exit have no caller min-shares/min-USDC/max-assets/deadline parameters. Oracle conversion and fee ceil/floor rounding apply; tiny positive deposit may produce zero shares. Fee calculations deduct configured fees even when recipient is zero, in which case fee funds stay in vault. Pause applies to deposits, redemptions and share movements. USDC restrictions can revert transfers; catalog does not grant legal eligibility or bypass underlying restrictions.

Its fixed stored strategy 0x5bE8c059A8E101d24B107aFb5A013feF505280b9 is explorer-identified minimal proxy to 0x770abd170404B8ed8182c04f380E567e647b457D; fixed stored escrow is 0x73A4518d87f23FDd9B289F7e3dcF5fa96b4a9Caa. Underlying is Base USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, 6 decimals; superUSDC shares also use 6 decimals. deposit/mint pull caller USDC via vault allowance and forward to fixed strategy. Configured entry management fee is skimmed from gross assets before shares; performance fees can reduce PPS. No native ETH, swap, bridge, hook, executor or aggregator routing admitted.

requestRedeem escrows shares and returns request ID 0. Controller MUST equal owner; caller must be owner or existing operator. It does not pay USDC. Keeper fulfillment is required before withdraw/redeem can claim existing USDC entitlements from escrow; maxWithdraw/maxRedeem are zero before fulfillment, not proof of no position. Approximate one-hour docs target is not enforced and large or liquidity-constrained requests can take longer.

Claims require controller or existing operator; controller can choose receiver, while operators must use receiver == controller. withdraw is exact USDC assets, redeem is a share-denominated claim at average fulfilled withdrawal price, not redemption of current wallet shares. Fulfilled shares are burned by strategy separately. Positive values that round to zero assets revert at strategy claim handling.

cancelRedeemRequest requests cancellation, not immediate share return. Manager must fulfill cancellation, then claimCancelRedeemRequest returns escrowed shares. While cancellation is pending new requests are blocked. RequestId arguments are ignored by implementation; use 0. Fulfillment may race cancellation and cancellation is not guaranteed immediate.

Deposit/mint have no user min-share/max-asset/deadline guard. Deposit and redeem-request depend on unpaused strategy and fresh, unexpired PPS; deposits additionally fail on global-hooks-root veto. Claim and cancellation paths do not run those strategy state checks. Request settlement has per-controller slippage tolerance, default 50 bps (0 selects default, not zero tolerance), without caller slippage parameter in the selected vault ABI. The separate strategy setter is not admitted in this direct-vault scope.

No vault-specific KYC/allowlist modifier appears on reviewed direct user methods; this is not assurance of legal eligibility or USDC transfer availability. USDC denial/pause, balances, oracle/keeper availability, configuration, rounding and escrow liquidity remain authoritative. functions.label: Kaito Claim matured KAITO from AgingPool
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory, not fresh RPC bytecode/storage/configuration or successful-execution proof. Active catalog status is not a live executability assertion. Balances, allowances, gas, canonical calldata, grants, catalog pauses and all independent policies remain authoritative. All admitted calls are nonpayable; send zero native value.

Base sKAITO is a direct StakedKAITO deployment, not a proxy. Underlying is 18-decimal KAITO 0x98d0baa52b2D063E780DE12F615f963Fe8537553; shares are 18-decimal sKAITO. Deposit/mint consume caller KAITO allowance to this exact vault; share amount is not raw KAITO amount. No permit or generic transfer authority is admitted.

Cooldown and synchronous exits are mutually exclusive modes. Constructor sets 7 days, but admin may set cooldownDuration anywhere from 0 to 90 days; no current duration is attested. With duration >0 use cooldownAssets/cooldownShares, which burn caller shares immediately and move KAITO to immutable AgingPool, then separately call claimFromAP(recipient) after maturity. With duration 0 only withdraw/redeem are enabled; any prior cooldown may be claimed immediately.

Cooldown requests aggregate per caller and each new request resets maturity for the ENTIRE accumulated lockedAmount. claimFromAP pays the full accumulated amount for msg.sender, not a user-selected owner or partial amount. No cancel request exists. Recipient must be a valid underlying-token recipient. Cooling funds no longer participate in vault share yield.

Blacklisting restricts caller/from/to share movement and withdrawal owner/recipient. Admin can redistribute blacklisted shares or burn them into vesting rewards; underlying rescue excludes KAITO. claimFromAP itself has no vault blacklist modifier, but must satisfy its own maturity and underlying transfer. Source does not require a deposit KYC allowlist; platform jurisdiction/sanctions/age restrictions and any separate launchpad KYC remain independent.

Nonzero assets and shares required; total share supply after deposit/exit must be either zero or at least 1e18 raw shares (global minimum, not a per-account minimum). Standard conversion has virtual +1 terms, rounds deposits/redeems down and mint/withdraw up. There is no caller minimum-output, maximum-input or deadline parameter. Remaining supply, rounding and share price can make small/full-balance actions revert.

Rewards are pushed by a restricted rewarder and linearly vest; constructor sets 7-day vesting and admin can change up to 90 days after current vest completes. No user reward-harvest call is admitted: claimFromAP claims an existing cooled principal amount, not separate staking rewards. No staking fee is charged in reviewed vault source; rates, funding, eligibility for off-chain incentives and financial results are not attested. Yaps retirement is not staking retirement; current official site still advertises native KAITO staking.

warnings: Static deployment-bound source/ABI inventory only, not a fresh runtime identity, current pool state, balance, liquidity, backing, successful execution or financial-safety guarantee. Only current-app Base Aerodrome N WETH-USDC direct Hypervisor 0xa0f688905ef05ea853c35131b4899a613b4ba644 is admitted. Constructor binds pool 0xb2cc224c1c9fee385f8ad6a55b4d94e92359dc59 and reads immutable token0/token1 from it. Official current app maps token0 to 18-decimal Base WETH 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006 and token1 to 6-decimal native USDC 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913, not USDbC. withdraw requires positive shares and nonzero recipient, then ultimately requires from == msg.sender and burns caller shares. Existing LP share allowance or approved operator does not authorize a different from. No LP approval is needed for the owner withdrawal. Outputs go to the explicit to recipient and remain WETH plus USDC, not native ETH.

Four minAmounts are base token0/token1 and limit token0/token1 liquidity burn minimums, not aggregate recipient output minimums. They are checked against amounts owed only for each nonzero liquidity position. Pro-rata unused balances are added afterwards. There is no deadline or aggregate min-output argument; floor rounding can reduce withdrawn position liquidity and dust outputs.

Before withdrawal, zeroBurn settles fees on both ranges, collects them to the vault and pays floor(owed/fee) to mutable feeRecipient. Source initial fee denominator is not asserted as current; owner can change fee without a range check. Zero fee can cause division-by-zero and block operations. Owner rebalancing/ranges, fee recipient, pool dependency and token behavior can affect or revert withdrawal. No onchain generic pause field exists in this exact interface.

Direct Hypervisor deposit is whitelist-only (msg.sender == whitelistedAddress), not ordinary user mint. No arbitrary executor, dynamic hypervisor target, opaque zap, or multicall admitted.

Withdrawal invokes typed burn/collect on constructor-bound immutable pool, not a caller-selected call target or payload. The separate mint callback accepts bytes but requires msg.sender == pool and mintCalled == true and pays configured tokens; it is excluded. No callback authorization or runtime nested-execution language is added.

Current official app identifies this vault under Aerodrome/Base and current official API recognizes the same chain/protocol/address. functions.label: Arcadia Finance Deposit USDC

This is Arcadia own lender wrapper, not a user-account arbitrary executor or third-party curator product.

Underlying Tranche locked or auctionInProgress flags block both entries and exits. LendingPool depositPaused/withdrawPaused are independently enforced; guardian can pause. No present pause/lock/auction state or future availability is attested.

Borrowing is collateralized through Arcadia Accounts; lender claims can be reduced by default/loss allocation and available cash. Tranche maxDeposit reports uint128 liquidity accounting capacity, not guaranteed executable room. Interest, auction, collateral/oracle and loss mechanics remain protocol constraints; no arbitrary Account, flash-action, account executor, bridge or admin capability is admitted.

functions.label: Extra Finance Supply reserve underlying
warnings: Static source/ABI inventory only: no fresh runtime identity, funding, liquidity, execution success, complete workflow or financial-safety assurance. Exact-function grants, canonical calldata/value checks, pauses and independent controls still apply.

Current October 12, 2026 Aero-upgrade notice pauses ALL new borrowing on Base and OP from October 14; it asks legacy AERO/VELO suppliers to redeem for token upgrade, but explicitly says other lending suppliers do not need to migrate. This admission is the maintained lender interface, not leverage farming, new borrowing, or a revival of legacy AERO/VELO products. Check the chosen reserve and current upgrade notices; no new leverage is admitted.

reserveId chooses an owner-created active reserve, its underlying/eToken/staking contracts and token decimals; amount is underlying base units while redemption amounts are eToken base units, not fixed USD. Base constructor WETH9 is 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006. Current per-reserve active/frozen flags, assets, capacities and cash are not attested.

deposit atomically pulls underlying from msg.sender using allowance to LendingPool and mints eTokens to onBehalfOf. depositAndStake mints to LendingPool then approves and stakes in the reserve-configured staking contract for onBehalfOf; this does not claim rewards. Existing collateral/debt delegation is not an allowance substitute.

Payable deposits use native ETH for WETH reserves when the entire LendingPool native balance is at least amount; otherwise they pull ERC20. Send exact intended native amount for ETH funding and zero for ERC20 funding. With msg.value>0 refundETH sends the entire remaining native balance to caller. Forced/preexisting native balances can affect this branch; no standalone prefunding capability is admitted.

redeem transfers caller eTokens using eToken allowance to LendingPool; uint256.max means caller whole unstaked eToken balance. unStakeAndWithdraw instead withdraws exact positive eTokenAmount from caller staking balance through lending-pool-only settlement; it does NOT implement max-as-all and does not claim accrued rewards. Outputs go to explicit to, not a delegated owner.

All selected calls require global !paused and an active reserve. Deposits additionally reject frozen reserves and capacity overflow; redemptions require sufficient available underlying cash. No queue, delay guarantee, minimum shares/output or deadline. Exchange-rate calculations floor, potentially yielding zero shares/output. Reserve fee is interest accrued via treasury share minting: initial 15%, owner mutable up to 100%, not a current fixed fee or deposit charge.

receiveNativeETH unwraps only when underlying equals constructor WETH9; unwrap transfers the entire LendingPool WETH balance after burn, not merely the quoted output. Other assets remain ERC20 even if the bool is true. Treasury/address-registry, reserve token/staking dependencies, reward loops, linked libraries and owner changes can revert calls. Library source is compiler-input evidence, not independently verified current library identity.

Official July 23, 2025 Terms require legal age and lawful eligibility and prohibit US persons/residents, PRC, Cuba, North Korea, South Sudan, Iran, Syria and named sanctioned Ukraine regions, plus jurisdictions where prohibited. ABI access does not waive these restrictions; no KYC/legal-eligibility conclusion is made.

Forced/preexisting native balances can affect this branch; no standalone prefunding capability is admitted.

redeem transfers caller eTokens using eToken allowance to LendingPool; uint256.max means caller whole unstaked eToken balance. unStakeAndWithdraw instead withdraws exact positive eTokenAmount from caller staking balance through lending-pool-only settlement; it does NOT implement max-as-all and does not claim accrued rewards. Outputs go to explicit to, not a delegated owner.

All selected calls require global !paused and an active reserve. Deposits additionally reject frozen reserves and capacity overflow; redemptions require sufficient available underlying cash. No queue, delay guarantee, minimum shares/output or deadline. Exchange-rate calculations floor, potentially yielding zero shares/output. Reserve fee is interest accrued via treasury share minting: initial 15%, owner mutable up to 100%, not a current fixed fee or deposit charge.

receiveNativeETH unwraps only when underlying equals constructor WETH9; unwrap transfers the entire LendingPool WETH balance after burn, not merely the quoted output. Library source is compiler-input evidence, not independently verified current library identity.

createVault mints the CDP ERC721 to caller. Borrow, collateral withdrawal and destroyVault require exact ownerOf(vaultID)==msg.sender, not merely an approved NFT operator. depositCollateral and repayments accept an existing vault without requiring caller ownership, spend caller tokens via allowance and do not grant ownership. Their onlyRouter guard permits direct users only while router==address(0); the explorer rendering observed zero, but owner can change it. No router/executor capability is admitted.

borrow/repay require an existing registered front-end vault ID with promoter in (0,10000]. _front is a fee-accounting ID, not calldata/executor. Source fees are converted into collateral and deducted from the borrower CDP, then credited to the front-end CDP. Opening fee is calculated on new total debt, not just newly borrowed amount; the collateral-ratio check precedes deduction of that opening fee. Insufficient collateral for fees reverts.

Borrow requires positive amount, funded MAI in the vault, current debt limits and sufficient oracle-valued collateral. Interest accrues with time and is capitalized on debt updates; repayment must leave either zero debt or at least minDebt. paybackTokenAll takes a timestamp deadline and transfers current accrued MAI debt; other selected CDP calls have no caller deadline/min-output/fee/rate guard.

Explorer rendering observed minimum collateral percentage=125, annual iR=1000 basis points, openingFee=closingFee=0, minDebt=10e18 and maxDebt=500000e18. getPaid claims already-recorded maticDebt entitlement in cbBTC despite its MATIC-based variable name; getPaid(address) can be triggered by anyone but pays only that entitled address, never a caller-chosen redirection of another account’s claim. Amounts use raw asset/share units; receiver, owner, unlockEpoch and depositId are distinct and must refer to the intended account/request. Requests can restrict share transfers. A third party requesting/cancelling or withdrawing on an owner requires appropriate allowance.

warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity or successful-execution guarantee. Balances, allowances, pauses, canonical calldata, grants and independent execution checks remain mandatory; zero native value for all admitted calls.

Arbitrum hub sUSDai TransparentUpgradeableProxy 0x0B2b2B2076d95dda7817e785989fE353fe955ef9; Blockscout reports implementation 0x4637193852dF85b7Ac05DD052B187460D81551f6. Underlying asset is Arbitrum USDai; Ethereum/Base/Plasma token deployments are OFT representations and are not user vault targets here. Deposits mint sUSDai at optimistic valuation; direct deposit/mint variants have no caller slippage bound. Overloads with minShares/maxAmount add explicit price limits; referral overload only records a referral code.

requestRedeem burns shares immediately into an asynchronous FIFO request for controller; caller must be owner or an already approved operator. Minimum request is 1e18 shares and at most 50 active requests per controller. No cancel-request function exists in the reviewed ABI.

withdraw/redeem are claim methods against already serviced controller requests, not instant unstaking. Caller must be controller or existing operator; servicing is STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE-only, cash-constrained and epoch-based, with potential partial fulfillment and multi-epoch delay. Request shares do not guarantee prompt USDai liquidity.

Pause and USDai blacklist restrictions apply; controller eligibility is checked explicitly and underlying transfers/share _update remain subject to blacklist checks. Deposits/mints are ordinary user calls, but do not bypass USDai legal, sanctions or transfer restrictions. No operator grants, permit, bridge mint/burn, multicall or loan callbacks admitted.

functions.label: MUX Cancel owned pending order
warnings: Static deployment-bound ABI/source inventory, not fresh runtime bytecode/storage identity, balances, allowance, liquidity, financial-safety or successful-execution assurance. Exact grants, canonical calldata/value validation, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory.

Arbitrum MUX V1 MUXLP OrderBook proxy is 0xa19fD5aB6C8DCffa2A295F78a5Bb4aC543AAF5e3. Current Sourcify proxyResolution reports 0xaB66dfEf3722Db73930A59147d900544D7B2AE90, differing from old official docs 0xFD92e0b7107488b095cA98E50BE128fee2a35879. Only actual current implementation ABI/source is used; service labels its implementation match/match, not exact_match. Linked LibOrderBook is 0x09a0dbd7667236106322f6254b605d51e36d4b6b and its bound source matches.

placeLiquidityOrder(uint8,uint96,bool) creates escrowed delayed order, not immediate LP mint or withdrawal. assetId is protocol pool asset index, not arbitrary call target. isAdding=true spends raw asset units and buys 18-decimal MUXLP; false escrows raw 18-decimal MUXLP and selects output asset. Inputs transfer atomically from caller; no separate prefund step.

For adds whose pool asset equals configured WETH, exact native ETH value rawAmount is required and wrapped internally; supplying WETH with zero value does not substitute. Other ERC20 adds require zero value and allowance to OrderBook. MUXLP sells require MUXLP allowance and should send zero value; the sell branch does not reject stray ETH and can strand it. rawAmount=0 is only a whitelisted-callback-account mode, not an ordinary zero-amount order.

Only brokers fill orders after mutable liquidityLockPeriod. Current docs say 18 minutes; older tutorial says around 15 minutes. Neither is asserted as current storage. Owner may set lock up to 30 days; cancellation requires order owner and mutable cancelCoolDown. No caller-set min output, price bound or deadline exists for liquidity orders, and no guaranteed fill time/automatic settlement is supplied.

cancelOrder(uint64) cancels caller-owned pending liquidity orders after cooldown, returns escrowed input (native ETH via configured unwrapper for WETH-backed adds; MUXLP for sells). This ABI also cancels owned position/withdrawal/rebalance orders under source-specific authority/expiry checks, and brokers can cancel expired position/withdrawal orders. It does not authorize creating those excluded leveraged workflows.

Filled outputs go to stored order account. Configured pool/oracle/broker prices, base plus dynamic imbalance fees, bid/ask spreads, 18-decimal normalization, flooring and liquid reserves determine result. No fixed fee rate or price is asserted. Pool requires enabled/listed liquidity asset and MLP-price bounds; insufficient reserves and dependency failures can prevent fills. liquidity-order pause gates fill, not placement or owner cancellation in this reviewed OrderBook.

Owner-configured callbackWhitelist causes fixed ILiquidityCallback calls on the order account before/after fill and after cancel, with configured gas limit; before-fill false/revert cancels, after-fill can revert, after-cancel failure is ignored. No arbitrary target or payload is supplied by these admitted parameters. No callbacks, callback administration, broker fills, rebalance, generic multicall, V3 prefunding helper or leveraged router is admitted.

Current official docs continue to describe V1 MUXLP buys/sells alongside V3. May 2026 wind-down forum topic is a community proposal, not an adopted shutdown notice; contributor Jean explicitly says protocol continues in maintenance mode with bugs addressed regularly. This is not a TVL/activity/performance assertion or guarantee of team continuity. No contract KYC gate appears for selected ordinary V1 calls; user jurisdiction eligibility remains independent.

functions.label: Nerite Add WETH collateral
warnings: Static deployment-bound source/ABI inventory only; no current bytecode/storage identity, execution, liquidity, collateral backing or financial-safety guarantee. Exact grants, canonical calldata, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory. All selected calls require zero native value.

Targets only the direct Arbitrum WETH BorrowerOperations branch, not another collateral, zapper, leverage executor, USND streaming, bridge or Liquity Ethereum deployment. Source keeps Bold names but debt token is official USND 0x4ecf61a6c2fab8a047ceb3b3b263b401763e9d49. Collateral is 18-decimal WETH 0x82af49447d8a07e3bd95bd0d56f35241523fbab1; native ETH is not accepted.

Opening pulls WETH collateral plus 0.001 WETH gas reserve from caller using existing BorrowerOperations allowance, mints USND to caller, and gives the position NFT to specified owner; trove ID hashes caller, owner and ownerIndex. Owner/addManager/removeManager/receiver fields are authority-sensitive, not arbitrary call targets: source stores managers and a remove-manager receiver. This catalog does not set or constrain them automatically or grant those roles. Separate manager-setting and batch-registration methods are excluded.

Increasing collateral or repaying debt requires NFT owner or allowed add/remove manager; zero addManager allows anyone to contribute. Withdrawing collateral, borrowing and closing require owner or remove manager. Outputs go to NFT owner unless an authorized remove manager has configured a receiver. NFT-approved operators alone are not accepted by these checks. Close burns caller entire USND debt and returns collateral plus gas reserve to the authorized receiver; no USND approval is needed for protocol burn.

Minimum debt is 500 USND (500e18), not Liquity 2000 BOLD. Annual rate is 1e18-scaled and source range is 0.5% through 250%. Debt increases accrue upfront fee based on branch approximate average interest and seven-day period, bounded by caller maxUpfrontFee. Rate adjustment within seven days can charge upfront fee; delegated rate authority and its bounds remain enforced. No assumed current rate or batch fee.

Repayment caps at entireDebt minus minimum debt; it can repay less than requested. Entire debt includes accrued interest, batch management fees and redistribution. Zombie adjustment requires zombie status, sufficient resulting minimum debt and valid hints to reinsert. Normal operations enforce current oracle liveness, individual/system collateral constraints and branch shutdown status; close remains possible after shutdown. No shutdown, oracle-failure or permissionless maintenance method is admitted.

Nerite-specific branch debt-limit checks apply on opening and debt increases; source constants include 75% stability-pool yield allocation and 0.55% redemption floor, not a generic Liquity interface substitution. WETH constants declare CCR 150%, MCR/SCR 110%, BCR 10%, but constructor reads registry parameters; constants are not asserted as live immutable values without state evidence. Governance-controlled debt limits and price dependencies can block borrowing.

claimCollateral pays only caller surplus previously recorded by the CollSurplusPool; it is not unrestricted collateral withdrawal. Fee arithmetic truncates integer divisions, and financial parameters/hints/receiver/owner/manager choices remain caller responsibilities. No deadline, collateral output minimum or automatic financial validation is added.

functions.label: D2 Finance deposit
warnings: Static exact-deployment source/ABI inventory only; no fresh RPC/runtime identity, successful execution, funding, rate or financial-safety guarantee. Existing grants, canonical calldata/value checks, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory. All admitted methods require zero native value.

Arbitrum42161 direct nonproxy VaultV1Whitelisted 0x75288264FDFEA8ce68e6D852696aB1cE2f3E5004. Underlying is native USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831 (6decimals), not USDC.e or native ETH. Shares also use6decimals. Constructor name/symbol HYPE++ is current registry Alpha Strategies branding, not a separate new protocol.

All four ordinary methods require whitelisted[msg.sender] OR strictly more than whitelistBalance of mutable whitelistAsset. This gates callers, including smart accounts/operators, even withdrawals; the catalog cannot grant eligibility. Constructor whitelist token/threshold are not asserted current. Owner can change whitelist, whitelistAsset, whitelistBalance and maxDeposits.

Deposit/mint pull USDC from caller using allowance to vault and mint shares to receiver. Only fundingStart <= now < epochStart and not custodied permit entry; current registry reports Trading and custodied=true, so admission does not imply calls are presently executable. Deposit/mint caps use totalDeposits versus maxDeposits, not simply vault cash.

Withdraw/redeem require not custodied and outside trading interval; caller must own shares or have existing share allowance from owner. No asynchronous request/cancel/claim queue exists in this implementation. If trader has custody, even scheduled epoch end does not unlock cash; trader must return funds and clear custodied. returnFunds can end epoch early and realize losses. No guaranteed redemption date; docs mention possible unwinding beyond expiry.

Immutable trader 0x8cABD8b787E8c69c5F24091CFdA197ff570345B3 can take whole vault assets for strategy execution during epoch. While custodied, totalAssets reports historical custodiedAmount, not live marked-to-market strategy NAV. Trader return amount may be lower. Owner schedules epochs (up to3650days) and capacity; source has no separate pause variable but custody/funding/whitelist gates can block operations.

ERC4626 virtual+1 conversion with decimal offset0: deposits/redeems round down; mint/withdraw round up. No caller-set minShares/minAssets/maxAssets/deadline exists. No explicit user fee deduction in this vault source; external strategy performance fees and accounting can affect returned NAV. Current official strategy guide gives HYPE++ example0% management/20% performance, not an immutable vault fee or current setting attestation. Rebasing/transfer-tax assets unsupported by source.

Current primary GitBook links production strategies and describes active V1/V3 vaults; official HYPE++ article supports Arbitrum access. Production/app/docs requests and browser hit Cloudflare. Staging also lists tests, so only independently exact-mainnet-source-bound Arbitrum target is selected; no test/staging-chain deployment is admitted.

Official terms restrict participation to legally eligible high-net-worth/sophisticated investors and prohibit listed territories including US,UK,Australia,China,HongKong,Switzerland and sanctioned jurisdictions, plus geographical masking. Contract whitelist is not legal eligibility. Managed strategy can use V0 Porto policy-engine custody; this inventory admits only the exact user vault interface, not trader/OMS/bridge/custody execution.

functions.label: Revert Finance Deposit USDC
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only; no current runtime identity, balance, liquidity, funding, successful execution, complete workflow or financial-safety guarantee. Zero native value; independent grants, pauses, canonical calldata and transaction controls remain mandatory.

Arbitrum native USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831 is the immutable asset, with 6 decimals; rlUSDC share base units also use 6 decimals. This is not bridged USDC.e, raw ETH, an NFT receipt or debt shares.

Plain deposit/mint pull USDC atomically from msg.sender using existing allowance to V3Vault and mint rlUSDC to receiver; they pass empty permitData internally. Permit2 overloads and all signature authorization entries are excluded. No standalone prefunding capability.

Conversions update accrued interest first. Deposit floors shares, mint rounds required USDC up; redeem floors USDC, withdraw rounds shares up. In this exact V3Vault implementation a withdrawal/redeem request exceeding owner share balance is clipped to that balance and recalculates assets, so requested exact assets may not be delivered. No caller minimum output, maximum input or deadline.

Withdraw/redeem burn owner shares; a different msg.sender requires pre-existing share allowance from owner. USDC goes to caller-chosen receiver. Exits require idle USDC and revert InsufficientLiquidity when insufficient; no withdrawal queue or fixed exit delay is provided.

Owner or emergencyAdmin can change global and daily lending/debt limits; zero or restrictive lending limits can block entry. Daily lending limit resets on UTC day number and exits replenish it. No current limits or perpetual unpaused availability are attested; this direct source has no separate lender pause flag.

Lenders fund loans against allowed Uniswap V3 LP NFT collateral, subject to oracle values, collateral/debt limits, minimum loan sizes, health checks and liquidations. Uncovered liquidation shortfalls can lower the lending exchange rate pro rata; reserve-factor interest deductions and dependencies affect conversions. No loan, collateral transformer, liquidation, arbitrary multicall or NFT callback surface is admitted.

ABI functions do not establish website, legal, jurisdictional or account eligibility; any applicable protocol and independent policy restrictions remain binding. No KYC clearance or asset-safety assertion.

Arbitrum native USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831 is the immutable asset, with 6 decimals; rlUSDC share base units also use 6 decimals. This is not bridged USDC.e, raw ETH, an NFT receipt or debt shares.

Plain deposit/mint pull USDC atomically from msg.sender using existing allowance to V3Vault and mint rlUSDC to receiver; they pass empty permitData internally. Permit2 overloads and all signature authorization entries are excluded. No standalone prefunding capability.

Conversions update accrued interest first. Deposit floors shares, mint rounds required USDC up; redeem floors USDC, withdraw rounds shares up. In this exact V3Vault implementation a withdrawal/redeem request exceeding owner share balance is clipped to that balance and recalculates assets, so requested exact assets may not be delivered. No caller minimum output, maximum input or deadline.

Withdraw/redeem burn owner shares; a different msg.sender requires pre-existing share allowance from owner. USDC goes to caller-chosen receiver. Exits require idle USDC and revert InsufficientLiquidity when insufficient; no withdrawal queue or fixed exit delay is provided.

Owner or emergencyAdmin can change global and daily lending/debt limits; zero or restrictive lending limits can block entry. Daily lending limit resets on UTC day number and exits replenish it. No current limits or perpetual unpaused availability are attested; this direct source has no separate lender pause flag.

Lenders fund loans against allowed Uniswap V3 LP NFT collateral, subject to oracle values, collateral/debt limits, minimum loan sizes, health checks and liquidations. Uncovered liquidation shortfalls can lower the lending exchange rate pro rata; reserve-factor interest deductions and dependencies affect conversions. No loan, collateral transformer, liquidation, arbitrary multicall or NFT callback surface is admitted.

ABI functions do not establish website, legal, jurisdictional or account eligibility; any applicable protocol and independent policy restrictions remain binding. No KYC clearance or asset-safety assertion.

functions.label: Umami Cancel own pending GM BTC vault request
warnings: Static exact-deployment ABI/source inventory only; no runtime identity, execution, liquidity, funding, complete-workflow or financial-safety assurance. Independent grants, pause checks and canonical-calldata controls remain mandatory.

Only Arbitrum gmUSDC BTC-backed vault 0x5f851F67D24419982EcD7b7765deFD64fBb50a97 is selected, not old GLP vaults or the ETH-backed gmUSDC whose deposit pause was observed. Underlying is 6-decimal native USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831, not bridged USDC.e; vault shares also have 6 decimals.

Deposit transfers caller USDC into this vault using allowance to this vault, then forwards a request to its configured aggregate vault. Receiver is explicit; zero is rejected in the bundled aggregate source. The immediate return value is an estimate, not minted-share or settlement confirmation. No standalone prefunding is admitted.

Redeem escrows owner shares in this vault rather than immediately burning/paying them. Owner must approve the vault to transfer shares even when owner equals caller; a different caller additionally consumes owner-to-caller share allowance. Receiver controls settlement destination, whereas cancellation refunds the recorded initiating sender, not necessarily owner or receiver.

Both deposit and redeem are payable because msg.value is forwarded to the aggregate for keeper execution gas, not ETH principal. Bundled aggregate code requires msg.value >= configured gas requirement times tx.gasprice and forwards all supplied value to rebalanceKeeper, without an excess refund in these entrypoints; documented approximately 0.001 ETH is not a fixed fee quote.

minOutAfterFees is forwarded into the pending request without local enforcement. Bundled aggregate source stores it for deferred execution; current exact aggregate/request-handler source and minimum-enforcement implementation were not independently bound, and no live execution/min-output guarantee is asserted. No caller deadline is present.

Conversions floor at the share price and dynamic fees can consume small inputs; deposit requires nonzero preview shares and capacity, redeem requires nonzero preview assets and sufficient aggregate USDC before it can even queue. Documented fees are 2% annual management and 20% yield plus dynamic entry/exit fees; actual configured execution-time rates may differ.

Requests depend on keeper/oracle execution, configured hooks, buffers and rebalancing; no fixed settlement delay or payout guarantee. cancelRequest checks exact vault and initiating sender, returns escrowed USDC or shares and clears the pending request; already cleared/executed or unavailable escrow requests can revert, and keeper ETH is not refunded by this function.

Explorer snapshot reports depositPaused=false, withdrawalPaused=false, aggregateVault=0x1E914730B4Cd343aE14530F0BBF6b350d83B833d and asset=USDC. These are point-in-time reported values, not persistence or runtime attestation. Configurator can pause operations or replace aggregateVault; the immutable AUTH reference is not automatically replaced with it.

Caller-selected callback variants, permit, approvals/transfers, privileged share accounting, pause/configuration and all views are excluded. The fixed configured aggregate dependency may revert or change; its source bundled in the vault compilation is contextual only, not an independently verified current deployed aggregate ABI. Umami requires lawful jurisdictional participation; no KYC eligibility or legal suitability is inferred.

functions.label: Sumer borrow usdc
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only: not proof of current runtime identity, execution, liquidity, funding, backing, financial safety or complete workflow. Independent grants, pauses, canonical calldata and value policies remain mandatory.

Arbitrum One 42161 sdrUSDC proxy 0x4DE3741E1676ed14d661b1398196dC221cA4D37A uses six-decimal native USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831; receipt sdrUSDC also has six decimals. This is Sumer own lending market, not synthetic-token issuer, bridge, or a generic Compound ABI. Selected calls are nonpayable with zero native value.

mint transfers caller USDC atomically using allowance to sdrUSDC proxy and credits caller receipts; actual transferred amount must exceed 1000 USDC base units (0.001 USDC) and minted receipt amount must be nonzero. Source controller auto-enters collateral membership on first clean deposit, and enforces market listing, mint pause, exchange-rate bound and supply cap; documentation no-minimum statement is superseded by exact deployed source.

redeem takes receipt base units; redeemUnderlying takes exact USDC base units. Exchange-rate multiplication/division floors. Unless redeeming the entire receipt balance, both burned receipts and underlying amount must exceed 1000 respective base units, and a remaining receipt balance of 1..1000 is rejected. Caller health, controller checks and market cash still apply. No slippage/deadline input exists.

borrow creates caller debt; controller checks listed markets, existing market pause states, borrow caps and collateral shortfall. repayBorrow and repayBorrowBehalf pull caller USDC using existing allowance, capped at borrower outstanding debt; third-party repayment does not grant borrowing delegation. Interest accrual, reserve factor and exchange-rate rounding remain material; no standalone prefunding or approval capability is admitted.

Borrow and redemption attempt configured timelock.consumeValue(amount). If that low-level call fails, the market transfers USDC to configured Timelock atomically and creates an agreement for caller instead of immediate payout. The timelock address is controller-configured, not a caller-selected executor. A failed dependency may still revert the entire call; no immediate receipt or payout assurance.

Timelock claim(uint256[]) can claim any recorded caller-beneficiary agreement, not only USDC agreements. Beneficiary must equal msg.sender; global and per-agreement freeze checks apply. Maturity requires timestamp + minDelay < current timestamp; before maxDelay the rate limiter must allow consumption, after maxDelay its reset-capable path is used. ERC20 output goes to recorded beneficiary; native agreements use a 5300-gas payment to that same beneficiary. No arbitrary target, recipient, calldata or bridge route input is admitted.

Explorer observation reports market isDeprecated=false, symbol=sdrUSDC, decimals=6 and underlying as above. isCTokenDeprecated=true is a deprecated storage classification flag, NOT the separate isDeprecated() market lifecycle result. Timelock frozen=false, minDelay=300 seconds and maxDelay=43200 seconds at observation only; mutable roles, upgrades, limiter state, agreements and balances may change or prevent claims.

Official current app vendor bundle binds arbitrum deployment addresses and token pair; main app maps networkId 42161 to nameInCompoundjs arbitrum. Sourcify reports exact_match for market, controller and timelock proxies and resolved implementations, not independent runtime persistence. Controller dependency is reviewed but its direct entrypoints are not admitted; no other markets or suToken issuer roles gain capabilities. Legal/KYC/jurisdiction eligibility is not established by this source inventory.

Stable conversion restrictions and current reserve flags apply.

Indexed accounting uses ray and percentage integer rounding; rates accrue and reserve factor allocates interest to treasury. Canonical Stryke includes the Dopex rebrand once. Only the current Arbitrum WETH/USDC OptionMarketOTMFE 0x2536974545c28F7C7d17038c7623E8132FbD82bb is admitted; official docs separately mark old Arbitrum/Base deployments deprecated. The market, current PositionManager 0x467f2E854C53DFC44e592600c4E0E9e86898E84b and UniswapV3Handler 0x6F73aFB6598d7a3881577f884f2E01574aEFC373 are direct contracts, not proxies; source service labels all match, not exact_match.

mintOption requires approvedMinters[msg.sender]; catalog membership cannot supply that eligibility. At most 20 ticks, approved pool/hook/TTL, minimum liquidity, configured strike bounds/max tick width and out-of-money checks apply. TTL is a fixed-expiry grid anchored at ttlStartTime, not simply now+ttl; BUFFER_TIME excludes the beginning of the grid cycle. No permissionless eligibility, app access, KYC/jurisdiction clearance or future availability is asserted.

For calls the caller pays WETH 0x82af49447d8a07e3bd95bd0d56f35241523fbab1; for puts the caller pays USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cc2239327c5edb3a432268e5831. Amounts are token base units. safeTransferFrom pulls premium into the market and any fee directly to feeTo using caller allowance to this market; maxCostAllowance caps premium plus protocol fee. There is no payable ETH conversion. Floor allocation can leave premium dust in market.

Typed optionTicks choose handler/pool/hook, not arbitrary selector or bytes. Market builds fixed use/donate payloads to its immutable PositionManager; manager requires approved handler/app pairing, and handler has its own app whitelist/pause. Registered hook callbacks, pricing, fee and verified-spot dependencies can be configured by governance; approved settings and external hook behavior are not continuously attested or isolated by this metadata.

positionSplitter requires the actual NFT owner msg.sender (approved operators cannot substitute), an unexpired option and exact liquidityToSplit array length. It deducts each split from original liquidity and mints a new option with the same expiry/strike/type to to; no ERC20 payout or extension results. Recipient must be intentional and contracts must accept safeMint ERC721 receipt. Subtraction bounds apply; no promise that a split is immediately exercisable.

settleOption is deliberately excluded: settler-role gated and takes dynamic swapper addresses plus opaque swapData, may pay profits to settler rather than NFT owner. Current LP mint/burn/reserve methods through PositionManager are also excluded because dynamic handler plus opaque hook-bearing bytes require scoped execution not provided here. Handler addLiquidity is not a substitute: it directly mints raw Uniswap liquidity to recipient without ERC6909 share bookkeeping and does not enforce its amountMin fields. No callback, arbitrary multicall, approval, raw prefunding or complete exit workflow is admitted.

functions.label: Steer Protocol Deposit WETH / USDC.e Smart Pool
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; no persistent runtime identity, funding, liquidity, execution, financial safety or complete-workflow assurance. Exact grants, independent policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value validation remain required.

Only Arbitrum 42161 vault 0xd5c92e97dd1cdb1bdc5fde5d2ef53a3935724fdc is selected. Current official docs label it WETH/USDC on Uniswap; token1 is specifically bridged USDC.e 0xff970a61a04b1ca14834a43f5de4533ebddb5cc8, not native Arbitrum USDC. token0 is WETH 0x82af49447d8a07e3bd95bd0d56f35241523fbab1 and fixed configured pool is 0xc31e54c7a869b9fcbecc14363cf510d1c41fa443. Both selected methods are nonpayable and require zero native value; outputs remain ERC20, not unwrapped ETH.

Beacon proxy resolves through EIP1967 beacon slot to 0x7be77aa7168ecad8059af15a7a12c3b47b2dc40e; current beacon implementation() reports 0xc1ecd10398a6d7036ccee1f50551ff169715081c MultiPositionLiquidityManager. Exact-match ABI/source is bound to that implementation, not an initial implementation assumption. Beacon owner can upgrade behavior. Vault proxy has no standalone verified source in queried Sourcify; actual proxy code and slot/getter responses are retained, without claiming an exact-match verifier result for the proxy itself or persistent runtime identity.

deposit pulls computed token0/token1 amounts from msg.sender directly into this vault using vault allowances and mints shares to intentional recipient to. It first pokes fixed pool positions and uses current proportional holdings, not an ERC4626 conversion. There is no owner/delegation input, arbitrary external-call target/selector/bytes, permit, standalone prefunding, router zap or manager strategy grant.

withdraw burns only msg.sender shares without a delegated-owner allowance route, then proportionally removes configured pool positions, collects fees and transfers both tokens to to. Recipient can differ from caller. shares must be positive. Deposits require unpaused vault and registry state PendingThreshold or Active; withdrawal has no whenNotPaused or registry-state modifier in this implementation, but this is not a promise of exit availability or admission of retired vaults.

Desired deposit amounts cap source-computed token usage; shares round down while proportional token inputs round up. For an empty vault, shares equal max(amount0Desired,amount1Desired) in raw base units, not normalized USD value. Set intentional amount0Min/amount1Min; these are minimum consumed/payout amounts, not minimum shares. Neither selected method has a deadline or min-share-output field. Withdrawal proportional liquidity and amounts round down; tiny withdrawals may burn too little position liquidity and differ from previews.

User value includes idle vault assets and concentrated-liquidity positions, net of accrued protocol/strategist fees. Source TOTAL_FEE=1500/10000 takes 15% of collected pool trading fees, allocated 6667/10000 of that cut to Steer and the rest strategist; it is not a 15% principal entry/exit fee. Pool trading fees, impermanent loss, strategy positions/rebalances and integer rounding affect outcomes. Deposited tokens remain idle until a later manager rebalance, which is not admitted or guaranteed.

Configured manager can tend/rebalance positions and Steer controls pause/emergency burn/fees; registry and beacon governance remain mutable dependencies. Pool callbacks have fixed configured-pool sender checks but are not activated as user capabilities. Existing pool/token/registry behavior remains authoritative, not isolated or attested. Amount-preserving standard WETH/USDC.e semantics are expected; transfer-tax/rebase/restricted tokens are not supported by the nominal accounting assumptions.

Point-in-time read-only configuration reports paused=false and registry state 1 (PendingThreshold), not Active=3; deposit source explicitly accepts either. This is a maintained officially listed pool, not a claim that strategy thresholds are met, liquidity is deployed, or calls will execute. Docs/app list and registry data do not grant app/jurisdiction/KYC eligibility, token permissions or financial safety.

functions.label: Hegic Claim position USDC.e profit
warnings: Static source/ABI metadata only, not assurance of current runtime identity, balances, liquidity, safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, pauses, canonical calldata and value controls remain required. All selected functions are nonpayable and require zero native value.

Exact Arbitrum Herge Stake & Cover pool, not legacy Ethereum V1/V8888 pools. HEGIC 0x431402e8b9de9aa016c743880e04e517074d8cec is cover collateral and USDC.e 0xff970a61a04b1ca14834a43f5de4533ebddb5cc8 is profit/payout token. Both are ERC20 token-base-unit amounts, not native ETH; native ETH only pays network gas separately.

provide pulls HEGIC from msg.sender using pool allowance. positionId=0 mints a new position NFT to msg.sender; an existing ID requires NFT ownership or approval, and funds accrue to that NFT owner. The first-ever position is admin-only. Entry is allowed only while now-epoch.start < mutable windowSize (source default 5 days); docs/UI mention 7 days, so do not assume that prose is current configuration.

provide floors amount*totalShare/coverTokenTotal (or uses amount when pool balance is zero), has no minimum shares or deadline, and can round small deposits to zero shares. It buffers accrued USDC.e profit before changing shares. HEGIC collateral can be spent to cover options losses; profit is neither fixed nor guaranteed.

withdraw is an asynchronous request, NOT a token payout: owner/approved caller specifies requested HEGIC amount, ceil-rounded shares are removed from position and queued in current epoch while totalShare remains until settlement. Final token amount depends on epoch-end remaining collateral; no fixed redemption price or immediate exit guarantee.

claim is permissionless but sends only this position's buffered USDC.e profit to ownerOf(positionId), never to caller-selected recipient. Profit uses cumulative floor rounding and admin fixProfit accounting, not an independent payout guarantee.

withdrawEpoch is permissionless but transfers final queued HEGIC and USDC.e only to current NFT owner. outFrom must contain completed epoch IDs with valid totalShareOut; current/future epochs revert, duplicates produce no additional entitlement, and zero-denominator epochs may revert. Pending profit is buffered then settled atomically; unwithdrawn collateral accounting is reduced. NFT transfer changes ultimate payout ownership.

Epoch closing is administered through fixProfit after strictly more than 7 days; permissionless fallbackEpochClose exists only after strictly more than 90 days and is not admitted as a trading capability. App mentions 30/45-day epochs and automatic withdrawals, but selected source requires explicit completed-epoch withdrawal; no exact timing or keeper promise.

Admin can alter entry window, payoffPool and next-epoch HEGIC conversion price and account/distribute realized profits; separately privileged treasury can exchange HEGIC for USDC.e through configured payoffPool allowance. This is economically shared options-writing exposure, not an isolated vault. No investor KYC/whitelist check appears on these entrypoints; no legal/app eligibility clearance is implied.

functions.label: Hegic Exercise existing option position
warnings: Static source/ABI metadata only, not assurance of current runtime identity, balances, liquidity, safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, pauses, canonical calldata and value controls remain required. All selected functions are nonpayable and require zero native value.

Exact non-proxy Arbitrum Herge treasury with immutable USDC.e token, PositionsManager and CoverPool dependencies; source-service exact_match for treasury, cover pool and manager, match (not exact_match) for sampled ETH call strategy. Configured strategies/pricers/limits/oracles remain mutable or externally dependent; review is not isolation from their behavior.

payOff settles an existing positionID, not a caller-selected new strategy. Treasury calls stored strategy.payOffAmount and isPayoffAvailable, requires now < expiration, unlocks its accounting then pays USDC.e to explicitly chosen account. For reviewed classic ETH call strategy caller must be manager NFT owner/approved, option must be ITM and within exercise window; recipient is intentionally not constrained to NFT owner. Choose account carefully. Other stored strategies can impose different source-defined eligibility and payout rules.

The sampled ETH call reads Chainlink ETH/USD, scales underlying amount by 1e18, price by feed decimals and payoff by 1e6 USDC.e, and floors integer division. Source does not independently validate oracle staleness/positivity. It delegates to fixed linked ProfitCalculator; no user-supplied target/selector/calldata is selected by payOff. Option payoff remains exposed to the stored strategy, oracle and treasury/cover settlement assumptions.

unlock is permissionless after strictly now > expiration and releases only treasury accounting, with no wallet payout. It cannot be used to claim expired-option value; an option must be exercised before expiry if applicable. Repeated settlement reverts through Locked state checks.

buy(address,address,uint256,uint256,bytes[]) is deliberately excluded because strategy is caller-selected and additional opaque bytes[] is forwarded before acceptance check. No router, seller, auto-exercise approval, NFT approval/transfer, arbitrary executor or new order-authorization surface is added. Existing positions may be exercised without claiming a complete purchase workflow.

Treasury may call immutable CoverPool to replenish USDC.e from its configured payoffPool when needed. Insufficient funds/allowance, current risk limits, epoch administration and stored strategy rules can prevent settlement. Admin treasury withdrawals/configuration and stake collateral conversion remain explicit economic dependencies, not safety assurances.
